youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Getting Clothes Altered
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的改衣服情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從帶著太長的褲子走進裁縫店、說什麼叫合身、量腰圍與內長、選改法與報價、別針試穿、約取件日期，到加換拉鍊與鈕扣、取回檢查線頭，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Getting Clothes Altered phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a customer walks into a tailor shop with trousers that are too long, learns what a real fit feels like, gets measured, chooses the hem and dart options and the price, tries the work pinned on him, books a pickup day, adds a new zipper slider and missing buttons, then inspects every loose thread at the counter. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you fix pants here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, du ju fɪks pænts hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你們這裡改褲子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, that is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du, ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 改的，那就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These gray ones are too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ɡreɪ wʌnz ɑr tu lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這條灰色的太長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much too long do you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ tu lɔŋ du ju θɪŋk?/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得大概太長了多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe four centimeters, or a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi fɔr ˈsɛntəˌmitərz, ɔr ə bɪt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 大概四公分，也許還再多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it touching your shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt ˈtʌtʃɪŋ jɔr ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 我看到褲腳已經碰到你的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does, and the hem is wet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz, ænd ðə hɛm ɪz wɛt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 是的，而且褲腳現在還濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain makes the bottom heavy and dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn meɪks ðə ˈbɑtəm ˈhɛvi ænd dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 下雨會讓下緣變重、顏色也變深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it drags everywhere I walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt dræɡz ˈɛvriˌwɛr aɪ wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 對，我走到哪裡它就拖到哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will wear a hole soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɪl wɛr ə hoʊl sun./
dialogue.zh: 再這樣穿很快就會磨出一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like this cloth a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðɪs klɑθ ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我很喜歡這塊布料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good wool lasts for many years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wʊl læsts fər ˈmɛni jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 好的羊毛料可以穿好多年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was a gift from my wife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ə ɡɪft frʌm maɪ waɪf./
dialogue.zh: 這條是我太太送我的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must work carefully on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi mʌst wɜrk ˈkɛrfəli ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那我們動工就要更小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister said you do neat work.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstər sɛd ju du nit wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 我姊說你手藝很細膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is sweet of her, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz swit əv hɜr, ˈtruli./
dialogue.zh: 她真是太客氣了，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she a regular customer here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ʃi ə ˈrɛɡjələr ˈkʌstəmər hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 她是這裡的常客嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She brings me things every spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi brɪŋz mi θɪŋz ˈɛvri sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她每年春天都拿衣服來給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am a new face in this shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ə nu feɪs ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我卻是第一次上門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome here any weekday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈwɛlkəm hɪr ˈɛni ˈwikˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 平常日隨時都歡迎你來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife chose them at the mall store.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf tʃoz ðɛm æt ðə mɔl stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 這是我太太在百貨公司挑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did they fit you right in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðeɪ fɪt ju raɪt ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 在店裡試的時候合不合？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bright light made everything look fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə braɪt laɪt meɪd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ lʊk faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 店內燈那麼亮，看起來都沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mall lights always lie to us.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔl laɪts ˈɔlˌweɪz laɪ tu ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 商場燈光永遠在騙人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At home they looked strange on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt hoʊm ðeɪ lʊkt streɪndʒ ɑn mi./
dialogue.zh: 回家一穿就覺得怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Longer than you wanted, of course.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ju ˈwɑntɪd, əv kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 當然，比你要的長度長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much longer, almost to my heel.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈlɔŋɡər, ˈɔlmoʊst tu maɪ hil./
dialogue.zh: 長太多了，幾乎快到腳跟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will cut it and sew a new edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl kʌt ɪt ænd soʊ ə nu ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我們會剪掉再縫一道新的邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you also match the two legs?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈɔlsoʊ mætʃ ðə tu lɛɡz?/
dialogue.zh: 兩條褲腳也可以弄一樣長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I check them side by side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ tʃɛk ðɛm saɪd baɪ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我會兩邊並起來對照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One leg seems longer than the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɛɡ simz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn ði ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 有一邊看起來比較長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That happens when the cloth hangs crooked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈhæpənz wɛn ðə klɑθ hæŋz ˈkrʊkɪd./
dialogue.zh: 布歪著垂就會那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These flat shoes are all I own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz flæt ʃuz ɑr ɔl aɪ oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 平底鞋我就這一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the hem sits just above the shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə hɛm sɪts dʒʌst əˈbʌv ðə ʃu./
dialogue.zh: 那樣褲腳剛好落在鞋子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no folding at my knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd noʊ ˈfoʊldɪŋ æt maɪ ni./
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋那裡也不要堆摺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folds come from extra length, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊldz kʌm frʌm ˈɛkstrə lɛŋθ, ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 有堆摺，就是長度太長造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is something else in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我袋子裡還有別的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look, what is that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk, wʌt ɪz ðæt wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看，那件是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A blue shirt, the sleeves are long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə blu ʃɜrt, ðə slivz ɑr lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 一件藍襯衫，袖子太長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shirt sleeves should stop at your wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɜrt slivz ʃʊd stɑp æt jɔr rɪst./
dialogue.zh: 襯衫袖口應該正好到手腕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These go past my hand a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ɡoʊ pæst maɪ hænd ə ˈlɪtl./
dialogue.zh: 這件的袖子超過手一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shortening a shirt takes more care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɔrtənɪŋ ə ʃɜrt teɪks mɔr kɛr./
dialogue.zh: 改短襯衫要更細心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a hard job to do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə hɑrd dʒɑb tə du?/
dialogue.zh: 那個很難做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cuff comes off, then goes back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌf kʌmz ɔf, ðɛn ɡoʊz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 要把袖口拆下來，再裝回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife sews, but she hates this.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf soʊz, bʌt ʃi heɪts ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我太太會縫，但她最討厭這種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny sleeve work is slow, I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni sliv wɜrk ɪz sloʊ, aɪ noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 袖子上這種細活很慢，我懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the pants first, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə pænts fɜrst, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請先改褲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Naturally, the pants come first today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnætʃərəli, ðə pænts kʌm fɜrst təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 當然，今天先從褲子開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The waist is also a little loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə weɪst ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ə ˈlɪtəl lus./
dialogue.zh: 腰的地方也有點鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How loose feels right on your body?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lus filz raɪt ɑn jɔr ˈbɑdi?/
dialogue.zh: 腰多鬆你穿起來才對？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can slide two fingers inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn slaɪd tu ˈfɪŋɡərz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我可以在腰裡塞進兩根手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fingers is actually a good fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪŋɡərz ɪz ˈæktʃuəli ə ɡʊd fɪt./
dialogue.zh: 塞得下兩指其實剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? I thought tight was better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli? aɪ θɔt taɪt wʌz ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我以為緊一點比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tight band digs in after one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə taɪt bænd dɪɡz ɪn ˈæftər wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 太緊的腰圍一小時後就會勒人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is just what happens.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt ɪz dʒʌst wʌt ˈhæpənz./
dialogue.zh: 對，我就是會那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we take in only a small amount.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi teɪk ɪn ˈoʊnli ə smɔl əˈmaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們只收一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son graduates in three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn ˈɡrædʒuˌeɪts ɪn θri wikz./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子三週後畢業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, so you need them by then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ, soʊ ju nid ðɛm baɪ ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 啊，所以那之前你要拿到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, and I own no other suit pants.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ænd aɪ oʊn noʊ ˈʌðər sut pænts./
dialogue.zh: 對，我沒有第二條西裝褲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we start today, no waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi stɑrt təˈdeɪ, noʊ ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們今天就開工，不等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today works, I have an open afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ wɜrks, aɪ hæv æn ˈoʊpən ˌæftərˈnun./
dialogue.zh: 今天可以，我下午有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the fitting room is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə ˈfɪtɪŋ rum ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 好，試衣間就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take them off right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ðɛm ɔf raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就把褲子脫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, first let's talk about fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, fɜrst lɛts tɔk əˈbaʊt fɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先別，我們先講什麼是合身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, one thing: do you fix only clothes?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, wʌn θɪŋ: du ju fɪks ˈoʊnli kloʊðz?/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，先問一件事：你們只修衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but I fix umbrellas too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli, bʌt aɪ fɪks ʌmˈbrɛləz tu./
dialogue.zh: 大多是，但我也修傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An umbrella? That really surprises me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ʌmˈbrɛlə? ðæt ˈrɪli sərˈpraɪzɪz mi./
dialogue.zh: 修傘？這我倒是很意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ribs break here all the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪbz breɪk hɪr ɔl ðə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 傘骨在這裡常常斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine broke last month, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn broʊk læst mʌnθ, ˈæktʃuəli./
dialogue.zh: 我那把上個月就壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it, it takes ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt, ɪt teɪks tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 帶來吧，只要十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shop smells like warm cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ʃɑp smɛlz laɪk wɔrm klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 這間店聞起來有溫暖的布味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My steamer does that, all day long.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ stiˈmər dʌz ðæt, ɔl deɪ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 是蒸氣燙鬥的功勞，全天都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that old machine on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt oʊld məˈʃin ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡牆上那臺舊機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My father bought it forty years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɑðər bɔt ɪt ˈfɔrti jɪrz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我爸爸四十多年前買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty years, and it still runs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti jɪrz, ænd ɪt stɪl rʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 四十年了還能動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs better than the new ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rʌnz ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə nu wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 它比新的還好用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people work in this shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈpipəl wɜrk ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 這間店有幾個人？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just me, plus one girl on Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst mi, plʌs wʌn ɡɜrl ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪz./
dialogue.zh: 就我，星期五再多一個女生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She does the buttons, I suppose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dʌz ðə ˈbʌtənz, aɪ səˈpoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我想鈕扣是她的活。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, her hands are faster than mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɜr hændz ɑr ˈfæstər ðæn maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，她的手比我快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like a good team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz laɪk ə ɡʊd tim./
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是很棒搭檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We talk little, we sew a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tɔk ˈlɪtl, wi soʊ ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我們話不多，但是縫很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need that kind of quiet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ðæt kaɪnd əv ˈkwaɪət naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在就需要那種安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a chair, sit down, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə tʃɛr, sɪt daʊn, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 那邊有椅子，請先坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, the pants. What is next?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ðə pænts. wʌt ɪz nɛkst?/
dialogue.zh: 那褲子呢，接著做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, tell me your idea of a good fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst, tɛl mi jɔr aɪˈdi əv ə ɡʊd fɪt./
dialogue.zh: 接著告訴我你心中的合身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A good fit means I forget it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd fɪt minz aɪ fərˈɡɛt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 合身就是穿著穿著就忘了它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forget the pants while you wear them?
dialogue.phonetic: /fərˈɡɛt ðə pænts waɪl ju wɛr ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 穿著的時候就忘記褲子存在？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, no pulling, no sliding down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, noʊ ˈpʊlɪŋ, noʊ ˈslaɪdɪŋ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 對，不緊繃，也不會往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best answer I heard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst ˈænsər aɪ hɜrd./
dialogue.zh: 那是我聽過最好的答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old pair pulled at the thigh.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld pɛr pʊld æt ðə θaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我那條舊的在大腿那裡會繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wool has no give, so we shape it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊl hæz noʊ ɡɪv, soʊ wi ʃeɪp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 羊毛沒有彈性，所以要用剪裁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shape it? I did not know that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪp ɪt? aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 用剪裁？這我都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small side seam can free your leg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl saɪd sim kæn fri jɔr lɛɡ./
dialogue.zh: 側縫收一點，腿就自在了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me inside the leg, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ɪnˈsaɪd ðə lɛɡ, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請給我看褲管裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, here is spare cloth for letting out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, hɪr ɪz spɛr klɑθ fər ˈlɛtɪŋ aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 看，這裡留了放寬的餘布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you can make it bigger later?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju kæn meɪk ɪt ˈbɪɡər ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 所以之後還可以再放寬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but only a little is left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtl ɪz lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過那裡只剩一點點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is plenty for me today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti fər mi təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天這樣對我就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stand up, let's measure you properly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stænd ʌp, lɛts ˈmɛʒər ju ˈprɑpərli./
dialogue.zh: 那就站起來，我們好好量一量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's begin with the waist then.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts bɪˈɡɪn wɪð ðə weɪst ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就先從腰說起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the waist is where it all starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə weɪst ɪz wɛr ɪt ɔl stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 對，腰是一切設計的起點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the band sit above my belt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ðə bænd sɪt əˈbʌv maɪ bɛlt?/
dialogue.zh: 腰頭該落在皮帶上面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it rests right on your hip bones.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt rɛsts raɪt ɑn jɔr hɪp boʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 不，它剛好靠在你的胯骨上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine are a bit low, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɑr ə bɪt loʊ, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我的腰線有低一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the pants ride at your natural waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə pænts raɪd æt jɔr ˈnætʃərəl weɪst./
dialogue.zh: 那就照你天生的腰線來車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the natural waist, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə ˈnætʃərəl weɪst, ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 天生的腰線到底是哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend sideways, see where your body folds.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnd ˈsaɪdˌweɪz, si wɛr jɔr ˈbɑdi foʊldz./
dialogue.zh: 你側彎看看，身體在哪裡折就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, there, just under my ribs.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðɛr, dʒʌst ˈʌndər maɪ rɪbz./
dialogue.zh: 喔，那裡，就在肋骨下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That line is your real waist size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn ɪz jɔr ril weɪst saɪz./
dialogue.zh: 這條線才是你真正的腰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And it must not gap at the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt mʌst nɑt ɡæp æt ðə bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 後面也不可以張開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, flat against you, no open space.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, flæt əˈɡɛnst ju, noʊ ˈoʊpən speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對，平平貼著你，沒有空隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine opens like a small wing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ˈoʊpənz laɪk ə smɔl wɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我的會像小翅膀一樣張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the waist is too wide for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ðə weɪst ɪz tu waɪd fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 那就是腰圍太寬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a belt can fix that, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə bɛlt kæn fɪks ðæt, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那用皮帶就能搞定，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A belt pulls folds, it never fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɛlt pʊlz foʊldz, ɪt ˈnɛvər fɪts./
dialogue.zh: 皮帶只會扯出皺褶，不會合身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, I always look wrinkled there.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru, aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz lʊk ˈrɪŋkəld ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我那裡總是皺皺的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fingers of slack, never more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪŋɡərz əv slæk, ˈnɛvər mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 留兩指頭的鬆度，不能再多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fingers, I will remember that.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪŋɡərz, aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 兩指，我會記住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One finger is tight, three will fall down.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfɪŋɡər ɪz taɪt, θri wɪl fɔl daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 留一指太緊，留三指就要往下掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the seat, is that a rude word?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə sit, ɪz ðæt ə rud wɜrd?/
dialogue.zh: 再來是屁股，那說法粗魯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here, we say it all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt hɪr, wi seɪ ɪt ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡不粗魯，我們整天都說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should the cloth sit back there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ʃʊd ðə klɑθ sɪt bæk ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 後面的布該怎樣貼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It covers you without pulling tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkʌvərz ju wɪˈðaʊt ˈpʊlɪŋ taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 蓋住你，但是不繃緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine shows two lines across.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ʃoʊz tu laɪnz əˈkrɔs./
dialogue.zh: 我的會橫著出現兩道拉痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those lines are a cry for more cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz laɪnz ɑr ə kraɪ fər mɔr klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 那兩條線是在喊布不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you add cloth there?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju æd klɑθ ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那裡能加布嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the seam has room to let out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə sim hæz rum tə lɛt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 除非接縫還有放寬的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if there is no room left?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðɛr ɪz noʊ rum lɛft?/
dialogue.zh: 要是沒有空間了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then these pants cannot be saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðiz pænts ˈkænɑt bi seɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 那這條褲子就真的救不回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is sad, but clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz sæd, bʌt klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 很可惜，不過說得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your pair has room, do not worry yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr pɛr hæz rum, du nɑt ˈwɜri jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 你這條還有空間，先別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the thigh part?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə θaɪ pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 那大腿這塊呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hand should slide in with space.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr hænd ʃʊd slaɪd ɪn wɪð speɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你的手能滑進去，還有餘地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it hugs nothing at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt hʌɡz ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 所以就完全不包肉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It follows the leg, it does not grab.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈfɑloʊz ðə lɛɡ, ɪt dʌz nɑt ɡræb./
dialogue.zh: 它順著腿走，但不抓肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When I sit, they cut my thigh.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ sɪt, ðeɪ kʌt maɪ θaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我坐下的時候，它們會卡大腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting is the real test of a fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪz ðə ril tɛst əv ə fɪt./
dialogue.zh: 坐下來才是合身的真正考試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sit all day at a desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɪt ɔl deɪ æt ə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 我整天都坐在辦公桌前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we leave one more finger of room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi liv wʌn mɔr ˈfɪŋɡər əv rum./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就多留一指的空隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the front need a crease?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə frʌnt nid ə kris?/
dialogue.zh: 前面要燙直線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A sharp crease makes the leg look long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɑrp kris meɪks ðə lɛɡ lʊk lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 清楚的直線會讓腿看起來長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that, my legs are short.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðæt, maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 我好喜歡，我的腿偏短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone says that, and almost no one is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn sɛz ðæt, ænd ˈɔlmoʊst noʊ wʌn ɪz raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 人人都這樣說，但幾乎沒人說對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my legs are not short?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ lɛɡz ɑr nɑt ʃɔrt?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我的腿不短？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are fine, the length was the problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr faɪn, ðə lɛŋθ wʌz ðə ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 很好，問題只是長度不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much fold at the shoe, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ foʊld æt ðə ʃu, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那鞋子上面要堆多少摺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One soft fold in front, none behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɔft foʊld ɪn frʌnt, nʌn bɪˈhaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 前面一道軟摺，後面完全不要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None behind? I always see cloth there.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn bɪˈhaɪnd? aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz si klɑθ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 後面不要？我後面都看到布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That long back piece is the classic mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt lɔŋ bæk pis ɪz ðə ˈklæsɪk mɪˈsteɪk./
dialogue.zh: 後面拖長就是最經典的錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who decided that rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu dɪˈsaɪdɪd ðæt rul?/
dialogue.zh: 這規則是誰定的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tailors, after a hundred wet hems.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪlərz, ˈæftər ə ˈhʌndrəd wɛt hɛmz./
dialogue.zh: 是我們裁縫，弄壞一百個濕褲腳以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The opening at my ankle matters too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈoʊpənɪŋ æt maɪ ˈæŋkəl ˈmætərz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 褲管口也有關係嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wide opening makes you look wider.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə waɪd ˈoʊpənɪŋ meɪks ju lʊk ˈwaɪdər./
dialogue.zh: 寬褲管會讓你看起來更寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make mine slim, but not skinny.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk maɪn slɪm, bʌt nɑt ˈskɪni./
dialogue.zh: 我的收窄一點，但不要太細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slim, yes. Skinny is not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /slɪm, jɛs. ˈskɪni ɪz nɑt ju./
dialogue.zh: 細一點可以，太細就不是你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a perfect line, write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈpɜrfɪkt laɪn, raɪt ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 這句話太棒了，記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have my chalk, I forget nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv maɪ tʃɔk, aɪ fərˈɡɛt ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我有粉筆，什麼都不會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the blue shirt, what is its rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə blu ʃɜrt, wʌt ɪz ɪts rul?/
dialogue.zh: 那藍襯衫，規則是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shoulder seam must land on the bone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃoʊldər sim mʌst lænd ɑn ðə boʊn./
dialogue.zh: 肩縫要正好落在肩骨上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine falls down my arm already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn fɔlz daʊn maɪ ɑrm ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我的已經滑到手臂上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the shirt is one size too big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ʃɜrt ɪz wʌn saɪz tu bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 那就代表襯衫大了一號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you move a seam inward?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju muv ə sim ɪnˈwərd?/
dialogue.zh: 可以往裡面移接縫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the sleeve has to follow it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt ðə sliv hæz tə ˈfɑloʊ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過袖子也要跟著改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not think of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt θɪŋk əv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 這我倒是沒想到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people never look at the shoulder.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl ˈnɛvər lʊk æt ðə ˈʃoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 大多數人根本都不看肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the sleeve end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə sliv ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 那袖子的末端呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops at the wrist bone, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps æt ðə rɪst boʊn, noʊ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 停在你的腕骨，不多不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under a jacket, should it show?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ə ˈdʒækɪt, ʃʊd ɪt ʃoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 穿在外套裡要露出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, about half a centimeter only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, əˈbaʊt hæf ə ˈsɛntəˌmitər ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 露一點，大約半公分就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half, not two. I always show two.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf, nɑt tu. aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz ʃoʊ tu./
dialogue.zh: 半公分，不是兩公分。我都露兩公分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is a sweater, half is a shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪz ə ˈswɛtər, hæf ɪz ə ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 露兩分像毛衣，半分才是襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is funny, but it is true.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈfʌni, bʌt ɪt ɪz tru./
dialogue.zh: 很好笑，但是是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The collar should also rest on your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɑlər ʃʊd ˈɔlsoʊ rɛst ɑn jɔr nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 領子也要靠著你的脖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine leaves a gap behind my ear.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn livz ə ɡæp bɪˈhaɪnd maɪ ɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我的在耳後會翹開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That gap says the neck is too big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡæp sɛz ðə nɛk ɪz tu bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 那道縫就代表領圍太大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the shirt stay tucked all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ðə ʃɜrt steɪ tʌkt ɔl deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 襯衫要整天塞著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It must be long enough to stay in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt mʌst bi lɔŋ ɪˈnʌf tə steɪ ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 它要夠長才塞得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine comes out when I raise my arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn kʌmz aʊt wɛn aɪ reɪz maɪ ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 我一抬手它就跑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A longer shirt tail is the fix for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɔŋɡər ʃɜrt teɪl ɪz ðə fɪks fər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 要它不跑出來，下擺就得留長一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can lengthen cloth? That is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ˈlɛŋθən klɑθ? ðæt ɪz nu tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 布還可以加長？這我是頭一回聽說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only from the spare inside, never from air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli frʌm ðə spɛr ɪnˈsaɪd, ˈnɛvər frʌm ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 只能用裡面的餘布，不能憑空變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a good fit means no marks on skin?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə ɡʊd fɪt minz noʊ mɑrks ɑn skɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 所以合身就是身上不留痕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No red lines at the end of the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɛd laɪnz æt ði ɛnd əv ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一天下來不該有紅印子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have red lines every single day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv rɛd laɪnz ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我每天都有紅印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your clothes have been too small for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɔr kloʊðz hæv bɪn tu smɔl fər jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 那你的衣服已經太小很多年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or too long, as we said first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr tu lɔŋ, æz wi sɛd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 或是太長，就像我們最開始說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both at once, that is very common.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ æt wʌns, ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkɑmən./
dialogue.zh: 兩樣一起發生，非常常見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the pocket corners?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpɑkɪt ˈkɔrnərz?/
dialogue.zh: 那口袋的角怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They should lie flat, not pop open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃʊd laɪ flæt, nɑt pɑp ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 它們該平平躺著，不要張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine pop open every time I sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn pɑp ˈoʊpən ˈɛvri taɪm aɪ sɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我一坐下來口袋就張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the seat pulling, not the pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə sit ˈpʊlɪŋ, nɑt ðə ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是臀部在拉，不是口袋的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the belt loops, do they matter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə bɛlt lʊps, du ðeɪ ˈmætər?/
dialogue.zh: 那皮帶環也有關係嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A belt must stand up straight in them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɛlt mʌst stænd ʌp streɪt ɪn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 皮帶在環裡要站得直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine flop over on both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn flɑp ˈoʊvər ɑn boʊθ saɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 我的兩邊都往旁邊翻倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the loops are too long, I can trim.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə lʊps ɑr tu lɔŋ, aɪ kæn trɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那就是環太長，我可以剪短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, are we measuring right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ɑr wi ˈmɛʒəˌrɪŋ raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那現在就要量了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, stand still and I will use my tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, stænd stɪl ænd aɪ wɪl juz maɪ teɪp./
dialogue.zh: 對，站好，我要用我的軟尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yours looks old and soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz lʊks oʊld ænd sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 你這條看起來舊舊軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old tape, honest numbers, that is my rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld teɪp, ˈɑnɪst ˈnʌmbərz, ðæt ɪz maɪ rul./
dialogue.zh: 舊尺、老實數字，就是我的原則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where exactly should I stand?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli ʃʊd aɪ stænd?/
dialogue.zh: 我確實要站在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the floor tape, that is my best light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə flɔr teɪp, ðæt ɪz maɪ bɛst laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 踩在地板那條膠帶上，那裡的光最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I stand like a soldier now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ stænd laɪk ə ˈsoʊldʒər naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要像士兵一樣站著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feet apart, arms loose at your sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /fiːt əˈpɑrt, ɑrmz lus æt jɔr saɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 腳開開，手自然垂在兩側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms feel heavy when you say that.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz fil ˈhɛvi wɛn ju seɪ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 你一這樣說我的手就變很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, I need the real you, not a pose.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks, aɪ nid ðə ril ju, nɑt ə poʊz./
dialogue.zh: 放鬆，我要真的你，不是擺姿態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep these shoes on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip ðiz ʃuz ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 這雙鞋要繼續穿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them, they decide your hem length.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm, ðeɪ dɪˈsaɪd jɔr hɛm lɛŋθ./
dialogue.zh: 穿著，它們決定你的褲長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These are my office shoes only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ɑr maɪ ˈɔfəs ʃuz ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 這雙只是我的辦公室鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will you wear a different shoe that day?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju wɛr ə ˈdɪfərənt ʃu ðæt deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那天你會換別的鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my brother lends me black boots.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ ˈbrʌðər lɛndz mi blæk buts./
dialogue.zh: 會穿，我哥借我一雙黑靴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boots change everything, bring them next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /buts tʃeɪndʒ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ, brɪŋ ðɛm nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 靴子會全變，下次帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time? Is today not enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm? ɪz təˈdeɪ nɑt ɪˈnʌf?/
dialogue.zh: 下次？今天還不夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today I write the first numbers down.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ aɪ raɪt ðə fɜrst ˈnʌmbərz daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 今天我先寫下第一組數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tape is cold on my waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə teɪp ɪz koʊld ɑn maɪ weɪst./
dialogue.zh: 軟尺貼在我的腰上冷冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, metal ends are always cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, ˈmɛtəl ɛndz ɑr ˈɔlˌweɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，尺頭都是冰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe out, or breathe in right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /briːð aʊt, ɔr briːð ɪn raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在該吐氣還是吸氣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just breathe normally, do not suck in.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst briːð ˈnɔrməli, du nɑt sʌk ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 正常呼吸就好，不要把肚子縮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always suck it for photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz sʌk ɪt fər ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我拍照時都會縮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth must fit the belly you really have.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɑθ mʌst fɪt ðə ˈbɛli ju ˈrɪli hæv./
dialogue.zh: 布料要合的，是你真正的肚子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fair, and a bit humbling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz fɛr, ænd ə bɪt hʌmˈblɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 說得對，也有點讓人臉紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty four, and a half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti fɔr, ænd ə hæf./
dialogue.zh: 三十四，再加半吋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A half inch? That is nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hæf ɪntʃ? ðæt ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 半吋？這什麼都沒有差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To cloth, a half inch is a whole size.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu klɑθ, ə hæf ɪntʃ ɪz ə hoʊl saɪz./
dialogue.zh: 對布料來說，半吋就是一整號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not know cloth kept score.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ klɑθ kɛpt skɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我不知道布也會計分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It counts every single one of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kaʊnts ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl wʌn əv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 它每一個小數都算得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, note that on your little card.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, noʊt ðæt ɑn jɔr ˈlɪtl kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 好，請把那個記在你的小單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I write them twice, look for yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ raɪt ðɛm twaɪs, lʊk fər jɔrˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 我都記兩遍，你自己看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your card is full of tiny boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr kɑrd ɪz fʊl əv ˈtaɪni ˈbɑksɪz./
dialogue.zh: 你的單子上全是小格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each box is one number, one promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /iːtʃ bɑks ɪz wʌn ˈnʌmbər, wʌn ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 每格是一個數字、一個承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my hips, I feel shy already.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ hɪps, aɪ fil ʃaɪ ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 現在量臀圍，我已經有點害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the mirror, not at my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə ˈmɪrər, nɑt æt maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 你看鏡子，不要看我的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mirror makes this feel like a fitting room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪrər meɪks ðɪs fil laɪk ə ˈfɪtɪŋ rum./
dialogue.zh: 鏡子讓這裡像在試衣間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a fitting room, that is my shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈfɪtɪŋ rum, ðæt ɪz maɪ ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 它就是試衣間，我店裡就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty one at the widest part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti wʌn æt ðə ˈwaɪdɪst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 最寬的地方是四十一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, I measured the widest part on purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt, aɪ ˈmɛʒərd ðə ˈwaɪdɪst pɑrt ɑn ˈpɜrpəs./
dialogue.zh: 對了，我就是故意量最寬處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the inside length called?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ði ɪnˈsaɪd lɛŋθ kɔld?/
dialogue.zh: 內側的長度叫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call it the inseam, from crotch to hem.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɔl ɪt ði ˈɪnˌsim, frʌm krɑtʃ tə hɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我們叫內長，從襠到褲腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please say that once more, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz seɪ ðæt wʌns mɔr, ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 請再慢一次說一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inseam: the inner leg seam, top to bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪnˌsim: ði ˈɪnər lɛɡ sim, tɑp tə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 內長：內側那條縫，從上到下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that is easy to picture now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðæt ɪz ˈizi tə ˈpɪktʃər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 喔，這樣我就想得出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift your foot on this small stool.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft jɔr fʊt ɑn ðɪs smɔl stuːl./
dialogue.zh: 把腳踩上這個小凳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, with my knee bent?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs, wɪð maɪ ni bɛnt?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎，膝蓋彎著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it straight, bending shortens the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt streɪt, ˈbɛndɪŋ ˈʃɔrtənz ðə ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 腿伸直，彎著會把數字變短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty two, is that a normal leg?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti tu, ɪz ðæt ə ˈnɔrməl lɛɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 三十二，這是正常的腿長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a very honest leg, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ˈvɛri ˈɑnɪst lɛɡ, jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 這是一條很老實的腿，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The outside length matters too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd lɛŋθ ˈmætərz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 外側長度也要量嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The outseam shows me your whole shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈaʊtˌsim ʃoʊz mi jɔr hoʊl ʃeɪp./
dialogue.zh: 外長會告訴我你的體型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the waistband to the floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈweɪstbænd tə ðə flɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 從腰頭到地板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To the floor, then I subtract your hem.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðə flɔr, ðɛn aɪ səbˈtrækt jɔr hɛm./
dialogue.zh: 到地板，然後我再扣掉褲腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Subtract? Now I need a calculator.
dialogue.phonetic: /səbˈtrækt? naʊ aɪ nid ə ˈkælkjəˌleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 要扣？那我需要計算機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My head does it while my hands work.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd dʌz ɪt waɪl maɪ hændz wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 我手在動，腦子在算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are faster than my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈfæstər ðæn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你比我的手機還快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phones die, this tape never will.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz daɪ, ðɪs teɪp ˈnɛvər wɪl./
dialogue.zh: 手機沒電，這條尺永遠不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the cuff opening, how wide?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə kʌf ˈoʊpənɪŋ, haʊ waɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 那褲管口要寬多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's say fourteen and a half, slim but kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts seɪ fɔrˈtin ænd ə hæf, slɪm bʌt kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 設成十四點半，細但客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slim but kind, you have a gift for words.
dialogue.phonetic: /slɪm bʌt kaɪnd, ju hæv ə ɡɪft fər wɜrdz./
dialogue.zh: 細但客氣，你很會說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I talk to cloth all day, it teaches me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɔk tu klɑθ ɔl deɪ, ɪt ˈtitʃɪz mi./
dialogue.zh: 我整天跟布說話，是它在教我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt sleeve, do we stretch the tape?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrt sliv, du wi strɛtʃ ðə teɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 襯衫袖也要拉尺量嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend your elbow a little, then I measure.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnd jɔr ˈɛlˌboʊ ə ˈlɪtəl, ðɛn aɪ ˈmɛʒər./
dialogue.zh: 手肘微彎，然後我量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why the bend? That surprises me again.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ðə bɛnd? ðæt sərˈpraɪzɪz mi əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要彎？又讓我意外了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A straight arm pulls the sleeve short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə streɪt ɑrm pʊlz ðə sliv ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 直臂量，動手時袖子就變短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I live with a bent arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ lɪv wɪð ə bɛnt ɑrm?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我一輩子要彎著手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two inches of extra cloth, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu ˈɪntʃɪz əv ˈɛkstrə klɑθ, ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 只要多兩吋布，就這麼點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Measure my collar next, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛʒər maɪ ˈkɑlər nɛkst, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 接著量我的領子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chin up, one finger under the band.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪn ʌp, wʌn ˈfɪŋɡər ˈʌndər ðə bænd./
dialogue.zh: 下巴抬高，帶子下面塞一指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the collar, you said band.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə ˈkɑlər, ju sɛd bænd./
dialogue.zh: 你說的是領子還是腰頭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Band, collar, waistband, all the same idea to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /bænd, ˈkɑlər, ˈweɪstbænd, ɔl ðə seɪm aɪˈdiə tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 帶、領、腰頭，對我是一回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are the boss of words today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ðə bɔs əv wɜrdz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天用詞你說了算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen and three quarters for your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ænd θri ˈkwɔrtərz fər jɔr nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 你的頸圍十五又四分之三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fractions make me miss my calculator again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfrækʃənz meɪk mi mɪs maɪ ˈkælkjəˌleɪtər əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 又有分數，我更想念計算機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fractions are where the fit lives, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfrækʃənz ɑr wɛr ðə fɪt lɪvz, maɪ frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 合身就住在分數裡，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my friend a size, or a number?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ frɛnd ə saɪz, ɔr ə ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 我這個朋友是一號，還是一個數字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are both today, and both are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr boʊθ təˈdeɪ, ænd boʊθ ɑr faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 今天你兩樣都是，而且都不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who writes all this into the book?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu raɪts ɔl ðɪs ˈɪntu ðə bʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 這些誰寫進本子裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The girl on Fridays, her hand is neat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡɜrl ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪz, hɜr hænd ɪz nit./
dialogue.zh: 星期五那女孩，她字很整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my name be in that book?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ neɪm bi ɪn ðæt bʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 我的名字會在上面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with a ticket number you keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wɪð ə ˈtɪkɪt ˈnʌmbər ju kip./
dialogue.zh: 會，還有一個你收著的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ticket, like a movie?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtɪkɪt, laɪk ə ˈmuvi?/
dialogue.zh: 門票一樣的是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A better movie, this one ends with pants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbɛtər ˈmuvi, ðɪs wʌn ɛndz wɪð pænts./
dialogue.zh: 更好看的電影，結局是褲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am laughing, hold the tape steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈlæfɪŋ, hoʊld ðə teɪp ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我在笑，尺拿穩一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laughing moves the waist, so stop for one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlæfɪŋ muvz ðə weɪst, soʊ stɑp fər wʌn ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 笑會動腰，先停一秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One second, done, I am stone now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd, dʌn, aɪ æm stoʊn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一秒，好了，我現在是石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the numbers are all on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, ðə ˈnʌmbərz ɑr ɔl ɑn ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 完美，數字都寫在單子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All that, and I still wear my shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðæt, ænd aɪ stɪl wɛr maɪ ʃuz./
dialogue.zh: 忙了一堆，我的鞋還穿在腳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your shoes stay on until the very end.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ʃuz steɪ ɑn ənˈtɪl ðə ˈvɛri ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 你的鞋要穿到最後一刻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You also write down my shoulder width?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔlsoʊ raɪt daʊn maɪ ˈʃoʊldər wɪtθ?/
dialogue.zh: 妳連肩寬也寫下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and your back length, for the jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd jɔr bæk lɛŋθ, fər ðə ˈdʒækɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，還有背長，外套要用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My jacket shoulders never felt measured.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdʒækɪt ˈʃoʊldərz ˈnɛvər fɛlt ˈmɛʒərd./
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀從沒被量過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hide under the collar, so people forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ haɪd ˈʌndər ðə ˈkɑlər, soʊ ˈpipəl fərˈɡɛt./
dialogue.zh: 領子會蓋住肩膀，人就忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Measure my knee opening too, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛʒər maɪ ni ˈoʊpənɪŋ tu, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 也量一下我膝蓋處的褲管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixteen around, that is a fair knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪksˈtin əˈraʊnd, ðæt ɪz ə fɛr ni./
dialogue.zh: 圍起來十六吋，這個膝圍很適中。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you get that number so fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju ɡɛt ðæt ˈnʌmbər soʊ fæst?/
dialogue.zh: 那個數字你怎麼算這麼快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My thumb and finger are my first ruler.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θʌm ænd ˈfɪŋɡər ɑr maɪ fɜrst ˈrulər./
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指和手指就是第一把尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ruler made of hands, I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrulər meɪd əv hændz, aɪ laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 一把用手做的尺，我喜歡這個說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It never breaks when I drop it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈnɛvər breɪks wɛn aɪ drɑp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它掉到地上也不會斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I want the real part, the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ wɑnt ðə ril pɑrt, ðə plæn./
dialogue.zh: 現在我要進入重點，就是方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plan needs my scissors and my price list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plæn nidz maɪ ˈsɪzərz ænd maɪ praɪs lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 方案要我的剪刀和價目表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Price already? We have not chosen anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /praɪs ɔlˈrɛdi? wi hæv nɑt ˈtʃoʊzən ˈɛniˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 就談價？我們還沒選任何做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come to the counter, see the choices in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm tə ðə ˈkaʊntər, si ðə ˈtʃɔɪsəz ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 來櫃台，選項我都寫在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This list is longer than my grocery list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs lɪst ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn maɪ ˈɡroʊsəri lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 這張價目表比我買菜清單還長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every line is one way to fix one thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri laɪn ɪz wʌn weɪ tə fɪks wʌn θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 每一行都是處理一個問題的辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then read me the pants part, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rid mi ðə pænts pɑrt, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 那就請你先念褲子那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shortening the legs: two options here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɔrtənɪŋ ðə lɛɡz: tu ˈɑpʃənz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 改短褲管：這裡有兩個做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two? I only wanted it shorter.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu? aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈwɑntɪd ɪt ˈʃɔrtər./
dialogue.zh: 兩種？我只想變短而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A simple hem, or a special one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsɪmpəl hɛm, ɔr ə ˈspɛʃəl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 一般褲口，或特別的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about the simple one first.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsɪmpəl wʌn fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先說一般的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cut, fold under, and stitch a new edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʌt, foʊld ˈʌndər, ænd stɪtʃ ə nu ɛdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 剪掉、摺進去、車一道新邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the special one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈspɛʃəl wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 那特別的那種呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep the original factory edge, invisibly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ði əˈrɪdʒənəl ˈfæktəri ɛdʒ, ɪnˈvɪzəbli./
dialogue.zh: 保留原本出廠的褲口邊，看不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Invisibly is my favorite word today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈvɪzəbli ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt wɜrd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 看不出來是我今天最喜歡的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs more because I sew it by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɔsts mɔr bɪˈkɔz aɪ soʊ ɪt baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 比較貴，因為要用手縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much more, in real money?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ mɔr, ɪn ril ˈmʌni?/
dialogue.zh: 實實在在要多多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain hem is twelve, hidden is twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn hɛm ɪz twɛlv, ˈhɪdən ɪz ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 普通款十二塊，隱藏式二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty for one edge of cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fər wʌn ɛdʒ əv klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 一條布邊就要二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two edges, my dear, both legs are hemmed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɛdʒɪz, maɪ dɪr, boʊθ lɛɡz ɑr hɛmd./
dialogue.zh: 是兩條，親愛的，兩邊都要車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both legs, of course, I spoke too soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ lɛɡz, əv kɔrs, aɪ spoʊk tu sun./
dialogue.zh: 當然是兩條，我說太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hidden edge also keeps your crease line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈhɪdən ɛdʒ ˈɔlsoʊ kips jɔr kris laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 隱藏式還能保住你的直線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sold me, do the hidden one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt soʊld mi, du ðə ˈhɪdən wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這句話說動我了，做隱藏式的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, the wool deserves that care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs, ðə wʊl dɪˈzɜrvz ðæt kɛr./
dialogue.zh: 選得好，羊毛料值得這樣照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the waist, how do you take it in?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə weɪst, haʊ du ju teɪk ɪt ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 腰圍部分你們怎麼收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the back seam, or from two side darts.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə bæk sim, ɔr frʌm tu saɪd dɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 從後中縫收，或在兩側車省道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Darts sound like a flying thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrts saʊnd laɪk ə ˈflaɪɪŋ θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 省道聽起來像會飛的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are small triangles folded inside the waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr smɔl traɪˈæŋɡəlz ˈfoʊldɪd ɪnˈsaɪd ðə weɪst./
dialogue.zh: 它們是腰裡折起來的小三角形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I feel them when I sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl aɪ fil ðɛm wɛn aɪ sɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 坐下來我會覺得有東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they hide flat under the band.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðeɪ haɪd flæt ˈʌndər ðə bænd./
dialogue.zh: 不會，它們平平藏在腰頭下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then darts, they sound smarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dɑrts, ðeɪ saʊnd ˈsmɑrtər./
dialogue.zh: 那就省道，聽起來比較聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They also cost less than moving the whole seam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ kɔst lɛs ðæn ˈmuvɪŋ ðə hoʊl sim./
dialogue.zh: 而且比移動整條縫便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less is welcome news today.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs ɪz ˈwɛlkəm nuz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天聽到「便宜」很高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Darts are eight, the full seam is fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrts ɑr eɪt, ðə fʊl sim ɪz fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 省道八塊，整條縫十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the shirt sleeves, what is the plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ʃɜrt slivz, wʌt ɪz ðə plæn?/
dialogue.zh: 那襯衫袖子，要怎麼做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shorten the sleeve, then move the cuff back on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɔrtən ðə sliv, ðɛn muv ðə kʌf bæk ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 先剪短，再把袖口裝回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The button hole moves too, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌtən hoʊl muvz tu, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 扣眼也要跟著移，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we recut one hole, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi riˈkʌt wʌn hoʊl, ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 對，重開一個扣眼，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds simple for ten dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈsɪmpəl fər tɛn ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 十塊聽起來很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple work is the expensive kind, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl wɜrk ɪz ði ɪkˈspɛnsɪv kaɪnd, maɪ frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 簡單的活才是最貴的，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who taught you that lesson?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu tɔt ju ðæt ˈlɛsən?/
dialogue.zh: 這道理是誰教你的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My father, after one very long night.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɑðər, ˈæftər wʌn ˈvɛri lɔŋ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我爸爸，在熬過很長的一夜之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long did that night go on?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dɪd ðæt naɪt ɡoʊ ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 那一夜拖了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He remade a cuff nine times before dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiː riːˈmeɪd ə kʌf naɪn taɪmz bɪˈfɔr dɔn./
dialogue.zh: 他在天亮前把袖口重做了九次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine? He was stubborn like you.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn? hi wʌz ˈstʌbərn laɪk ju./
dialogue.zh: 九次？他跟你一樣固執。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call that careful, and we are right.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɔl ðæt ˈkɛrfəl, ænd wi ɑr raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們那叫認真，而且我們是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so what is my total?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, soʊ wʌt ɪz maɪ ˈtoʊtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我的總價是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty for the hems, eight for the darts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti fər ðə hɛmz, eɪt fər ðə dɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 褲口二十，省道八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the shirt is ten more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ʃɜrt ɪz tɛn mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 襯衫再加十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, thirty eight, before tax and thread.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈθɜrti eɪt, bɪˈfɔr tæks ænd θrɛd./
dialogue.zh: 對，三十八，稅和線另計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thread costs extra? Nobody told me that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θrɛd kɔsts ˈɛkstrə? ˈnoʊˌbɑdi toʊld mi ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 線也要另外算錢？沒有人跟我這樣說過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thread is free, I liked how it sounded.
dialogue.phonetic: /θrɛd ɪz fri, aɪ laɪkt haʊ ɪt ˈsaʊndɪd./
dialogue.zh: 線是免費的，我只是講得好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You tricked me, and I laughed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju trɪkt mi, ænd aɪ læft./
dialogue.zh: 你騙我，而且我笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free thread, free pressing, free loose end trimming.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri θrɛd, fri ˈprɛsɪŋ, fri lus ɛnd ˈtrɪmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 線免費、燙整免費、剪線頭也免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressing is included? That is generous.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɛsɪŋ ɪz ˌɪnˈkludɪd? ðæt ɪz ˈdʒɛnərəs./
dialogue.zh: 燙整也包含？真大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A crooked crease makes me look bad, so yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkrʊkɪd kris meɪks mi lʊk bæd, soʊ jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 線歪我會難看，所以要燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a cheaper way to do this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈtʃipər weɪ tə du ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有比較便宜的做法？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could hem it yourself at home tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊd hɛm ɪt jɔrˈsɛlf æt hoʊm təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你今晚在家自己車也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot sew a straight line at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt soʊ ə streɪt laɪn æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我連一條直線都縫不直。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we stay at thirty eight, and you rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi steɪ æt ˈθɜrti eɪt, ænd ju rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 那就三十八，你負責休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. The mall charges more than this.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr. ðə mɔl ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz mɔr ðæn ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 公道。百貨公司收得比這裡多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mall machine is faster, not better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mɔl məˈʃin ɪz ˈfæstər, nɑt ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 商場機器比較快，不是比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their last hem opened in one week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr læst hɛm ˈoʊpənd ɪn wʌn wik./
dialogue.zh: 他們上次改的褲口一週就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That stitch was rushed, I have seen it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt stɪtʃ wʌz rʌʃt, aɪ hæv sin ɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那種針就是趕出來的，我修過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then take your time with mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk jɔr taɪm wɪð maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那我的請你慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rush jobs cost extra here, never free.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌʃ dʒɑbz kɔst ˈɛkstrə hɪr, ˈnɛvər fri./
dialogue.zh: 急件在這裡要加錢，從不免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid? Even for my son's big day?
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪd? ˈivən fər maɪ sʌnz bɪɡ deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 收費？我兒子的重大日子也收費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a big day I start early, not fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ə bɪɡ deɪ aɪ stɑrt ˈɜrli, nɑt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 大日子我可以早起，但不能草率。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a kind offer, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə kaɪnd ˈɔfər, ˈtruli./
dialogue.zh: 這條件真是厚道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One catch, though: early pickup costs more.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kætʃ, ðoʊ: ˈɜrli ˈpɪkˌʌp kɔsts mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 不過有一點：早上取件要多花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is a rush fee here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ bɪɡ ɪz ə rʌʃ fi hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你們的急件費是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half of the total, so plan one more day.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf əv ðə ˈtoʊtəl, soʊ plæn wʌn mɔr deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 總價的一半，所以請多留一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A day it is, my wallet thanks you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə deɪ ɪt ɪz, maɪ ˈwɑlət θæŋks ju./
dialogue.zh: 那就多留一天，我的錢包謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your wallet and I agree on that plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈwɑlət ænd aɪ əˈɡri ɑn ðæt plæn./
dialogue.zh: 你的錢包跟我的看法一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add the coat while I am here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æd ðə koʊt waɪl aɪ æm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我能不能順便加一件外套？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but let's finish these two first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, bʌt lɛts ˈfɪnɪʃ ðiz tu fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但先把這兩件處理完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question on price, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən ɑn praɪs, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那再問一個價格的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask, I have no secrets in my list.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk, aɪ hæv noʊ ˈsikəts ɪn maɪ lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 你問，我的價目表沒有秘密。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you charge for a second fitting?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju tʃɑrdʒ fər ə ˈsɛkənd ˈfɪtɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 第二次試穿要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second fitting is free if the first was mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd ˈfɪtɪŋ ɪz fri ɪf ðə fɜrst wʌz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 如果第一次是我量的，免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I want more length back later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ wɑnt mɔr lɛŋθ bæk ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 要是我以後又想放量呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is a new job, a new price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt ɪz ə nu dʒɑb, ə nu praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那就是新的工作、新的價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, I am decided on everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd, aɪ æm dɪˈsaɪdɪd ɑn ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我懂，這些我都決定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hidden hem, two darts, shorter sleeves, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪdən hɛm, tu dɑrts, ˈʃɔrtər slivz, jɛs?/
dialogue.zh: 暗裝褲口、兩個省道、袖子改短，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes to all of that, in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ɔl əv ðæt, ɪn ˈraɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 對，全部都要，請寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Written, signed, and one copy for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtən, saɪnd, ænd wʌn ˈkɑpi fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 寫好了、簽名了，給你一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A deposit, or all now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dɪˈpɑzət, ɔr ɔl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 定金還是全額？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half now, half when you take the pants home.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf naʊ, hæf wɛn ju teɪk ðə pænts hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 現在一半，取褲子時再一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And to move the coat pockets higher?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tə muv ðə koʊt ˈpɑkɪts ˈhaɪər?/
dialogue.zh: 還有把外套口袋往上移呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight, since the bag comes out too.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt, sɪns ðə bæɡ kʌmz aʊt tu./
dialogue.zh: 八塊，因為袋布也要一起拆出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skip that, then, the pockets are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ðæt, ðɛn, ðə ˈpɑkɪts ɑr faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那就免了，口袋這樣就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then your money stays in your pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðɛn jɔr ˈmʌni steɪz ɪn jɔr ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，那你的錢就留住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is hand sewing always more than machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hænd ˈsoʊɪŋ ˈɔlˌweɪz mɔr ðæn məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 手縫是不是都比機器貴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my hands cost more than my motor.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, maɪ hændz kɔst mɔr ðæn maɪ ˈmoʊtər./
dialogue.zh: 對，我的手比我的馬達貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you learn to say that?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju lɜrn tə seɪ ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 這話你是跟誰學的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My price list says it, I only read.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ praɪs lɪst sɛz ɪt, aɪ ˈoʊnli rid./
dialogue.zh: 是價目表說的，我只是照念。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What cannot be fixed in my gray pants?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈkænɑt bi fɪkst ɪn maɪ ɡreɪ pænts?/
dialogue.zh: 我的灰褲子有什麼是改不了的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The knee, if the cloth is thin there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ni, ɪf ðə klɑθ ɪz θɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 是膝蓋，如果那裡的布變薄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees look shiny, is that thin?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz lʊk ˈʃaɪni, ɪz ðæt θɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋看起來亮亮的，那是布薄了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I call you before I cut anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kɔl ju bɪˈfɔr aɪ kʌt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那我下剪前會先打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You call? That is rare these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kɔl? ðæt ɪz rɛr ðiz deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 你會打電話？這年頭很少見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A surprise on a seam is a lost friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sərˈpraɪz ɑn ə sim ɪz ə lɔst frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 縫線上的驚喜，就是失去的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pay half now, then, and the rest Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ hæf naʊ, ðɛn, ænd ðə rɛst ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那就先付一半，剩下的星期五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now put these on and let me pin them.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ pʊt ðiz ɑn ænd lɛt mi pɪn ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 現在請穿上，讓我別針做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I change, in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ tʃeɪndʒ, ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡換衣服，那邊間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the curtain is clean, I washed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈkɜrtən ɪz klin, aɪ wɑʃt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，簾子是乾淨的，我才洗過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You wash the fitting room curtain?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɑʃ ðə ˈfɪtɪŋ rum ˈkɜrtən?/
dialogue.zh: 你會去洗試衣間的簾子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every week, with the shop towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri wik, wɪð ðə ʃɑp ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 每週跟店裡的毛巾一起洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am back, and I feel silly already.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm bæk, ænd aɪ fil ˈsɪli ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我回來了，覺得自己有點傻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half of my customers feel silly here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf əv maɪ ˈkʌstəmərz fil ˈsɪli hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我一半的客人在這裡都覺得傻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The other half looks confident?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈʌðər hæf lʊks ˈkɑnfədənt?/
dialogue.zh: 另一半看起來很自信嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they are just slower to move.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðeɪ ɑr dʒʌst ˈsloʊər tə muv./
dialogue.zh: 不，他們只是動作比較慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel better now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi fil ˈbɛtər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那我現在就好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn around slowly, let me see the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn əˈraʊnd ˈsloʊli, lɛt mi si ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉一圈，讓我看後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, spinning in your shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs, ˈspɪnɪŋ ɪn jɔr ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣，在你店裡轉圈圈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop, hold, I see the problem line.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp, hoʊld, aɪ si ðə ˈprɑbləm laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 停，別動，我看到問題那條線了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where? I see only gray cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr? aɪ si ˈoʊnli ɡreɪ klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？我只看到灰色布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this wrinkle pulls from your hip.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, ðɪs ˈrɪŋkəl pʊlz frʌm jɔr hɪp./
dialogue.zh: 這裡，這道皺紋是從胯拉出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wrinkle can tell you that much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrɪŋkəl kæn tɛl ju ðæt mʌtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 一道皺紋能告訴你這麼多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth talks loudly, most people do not listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɑθ tɔks ˈlaʊdli, moʊst ˈpipəl du nɑt ˈlɪsən./
dialogue.zh: 布說話很大聲，多數人不聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, I am listening right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən, aɪ æm ˈlɪsənɪŋ raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 聽，我現在就在聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, hold this pose, I need my pins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, hoʊld ðɪs poʊz, aɪ nid maɪ pɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 好，保持這個姿勢，我要別針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pins is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni pɪnz ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 那要用多少個別針？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four at the waist, two at each hem.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr æt ðə weɪst, tu æt itʃ hɛm./
dialogue.zh: 腰上四個，兩邊褲腳各兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight pins on my body today.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt pɪnz ɑn maɪ ˈbɑdi təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天要有八個針別在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, I almost forgot the shirt one.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn, aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst fərˈɡɑt ðə ʃɜrt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 九個，我差點忘了襯衫那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shirt is pinned too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɜrt ɪz pɪnd tu?/
dialogue.zh: 襯衫也要別針？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pin at the shoulder, to show the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pɪn æt ðə ˈʃoʊldər, tə ʃoʊ ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 肩上別一個，標示新線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take the shirt off as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk ðə ʃɜrt ɔf æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 襯衫也要脫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, first walk for me, normal speed.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, fɜrst wɔk fər mi, ˈnɔrməl spid./
dialogue.zh: 先別，請照平常速度走幾步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking in a shop, how strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔkɪŋ ɪn ə ʃɑp, haʊ streɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 在店裡走路，真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One loop, then sit on that low chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn luːp, ðɛn sɪt ɑn ðæt loʊ tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 走一圈，再坐那張矮椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting with nine pins in me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ wɪð naɪn pɪnz ɪn mi?/
dialogue.zh: 坐著？我身上有九個針。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold the cloth, you just sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə klɑθ, ju dʒʌst sɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我扶著布，你坐就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I sit, and nothing pulls.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ sɪt, ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ pʊlz./
dialogue.zh: 好，我坐下了，沒有繃住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the waistband stays flat on your belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə ˈweɪstbænd steɪz flæt ɑn jɔr ˈbɛli./
dialogue.zh: 看，腰頭平平貼在你的肚子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is new, my bands never stay flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz nu, maɪ bændz ˈnɛvər steɪ flæt./
dialogue.zh: 這很新鮮，我的腰頭從來不平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because yours were made for a stranger.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈkɔz jʊrz wɜr meɪd fər ə ˈstreɪndʒər./
dialogue.zh: 因為你以前那些，根本是為陌生人做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A stranger? But I chose them myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstreɪndʒər? bʌt aɪ tʃoʊz ðɛm maɪˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 陌生人？可是我親手挑的啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store cut one shape for every man.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɔr kʌt wʌn ʃeɪp fər ˈɛvri mæn./
dialogue.zh: 店家只為所有男人車一個版型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And you cut it for one man.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju kʌt ɪt fər wʌn mæn./
dialogue.zh: 而你是為一個人車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For you, today, with my own two hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ju, təˈdeɪ, wɪð maɪ oʊn tu hændz./
dialogue.zh: 為你，今天，用我這兩隻手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds almost like a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈɔlmoʊst laɪk ə ɡɪft./
dialogue.zh: 這聽起來幾乎像份禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand up now, I must mark the hem line.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ʌp naʊ, aɪ mʌst mɑrk ðə hɛm laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 現在站起來，我要畫褲腳線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That white line is your chalk?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt waɪt laɪn ɪz jɔr tʃɔk?/
dialogue.zh: 那道白線是你的粉筆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tailor chalk, it brushes off the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪlər tʃɔk, ɪt brʌʃɪz ɔf ðə klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 裁縫粉筆，會刷掉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly off, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ɔf, aɪ hoʊp./
dialogue.zh: 我希望能幾乎都刷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wool forgets chalk, cotton sometimes does not.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊl fərˈɡɛts tʃɔk, ˈkɑtən ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz dʌz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 羊毛會忘記粉筆，棉有時候不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These are wool, so I am safe today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ɑr wʊl, soʊ aɪ æm seɪf təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這條是羊毛，所以我今天安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe, and slightly white on the left leg.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf, ænd ˈslaɪtli waɪt ɑn ðə lɛft lɛɡ./
dialogue.zh: 安全，不過左褲腿有點白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are joking, I can see chalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr dʒoʊkɪŋ, aɪ kæn si tʃɔk./
dialogue.zh: 你在開玩笑，我看得見粉筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am never joking about hem lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈnɛvər dʒoʊkɪŋ əˈbaʊt hɛm laɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 關於褲腳線我從不開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both lines the same height?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ laɪnz ðə seɪm haɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 兩條線一樣高嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I measure from the floor, not from your eye.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈmɛʒər frʌm ðə flɔr, nɑt frʌm jɔr aɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我從地板量，不是用眼睛看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your eye would be faster here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr aɪ wʊd bi ˈfæstər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 用眼睛看應該比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eye lies, my tape never lies.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ aɪ laɪz, maɪ teɪp ˈnɛvər laɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛會說謊，尺不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hem is longer, I knew it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɛm ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər, aɪ nu ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一邊長一點，我就知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half an inch, from the way you stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ən ɪntʃ, frʌm ðə weɪ ju stænd./
dialogue.zh: 半吋，是你的站姿造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stand crooked, my mother said so.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stænd ˈkrʊkɪd, maɪ ˈmʌðər sɛd soʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我站得歪，我媽媽就這樣說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I cut for your crooked, it fits better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kʌt fər jɔr ˈkrʊkɪd, ɪt fɪts ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 那我就照你的歪來剪，反而合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody ever cut for my crooked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ˈɛvər kʌt fər maɪ ˈkrʊkɪd./
dialogue.zh: 從來沒有人照我的歪去剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold still, the pin is at your knee now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld stɪl, ðə pɪn ɪz æt jɔr ni naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 別動，針現在在你膝蓋邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ouch, that one found real skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ, ðæt wʌn faʊnd ril skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，這個真的戳到皮膚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, sorry, tell me when to stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, ˈsɑri, tɛl mi wɛn tə stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉抱歉，痛就告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said sorry well, I forgive you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ˈsɑri wɛl, aɪ fərˈɡɪv ju./
dialogue.zh: 你說抱歉說得很好，我原諒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the jacket, put it over the shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈdʒækɪt, pʊt ɪt ˈoʊvər ðə ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 現在試外套，披在襯衫上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This jacket fits me fine already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈdʒækɪt fɪts mi faɪn ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 這件外套我穿起來剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look, nothing fits until I look.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk, ˈnʌθɪŋ fɪts ənˈtɪl aɪ lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看，我看過才算合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shoulders feel fine to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃoʊldərz fil faɪn tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 肩膀我覺得沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your right shoulder drops a little lower.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr raɪt ˈʃoʊldər drɑps ə ˈlɪtəl ˈloʊər./
dialogue.zh: 你右邊肩膀低了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lower shoulder? I never knew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈloʊər ˈʃoʊldər? aɪ ˈnɛvər nu./
dialogue.zh: 肩膀低？我都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost everyone has one, it is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛvriˌwʌn hæz wʌn, ɪt ɪz ˈnɔrməl./
dialogue.zh: 幾乎人人都有，很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the sleeve length changes on one side?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə sliv lɛŋθ ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ɑn wʌn saɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 所以一邊的袖長要不一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one pin here, see how it hangs now?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn pɪn hɪr, si haʊ ɪt hæŋz naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 對，這裡別一針，看現在垂得多好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a small trick, big result.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə smɔl trɪk, bɪɡ rɪˈzʌlt./
dialogue.zh: 小手法，大差別。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now raise both arms, then cross them.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ reɪz boʊθ ɑrmz, ðɛn krɔs ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 現在舉起雙手，再交叉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crossing arms in a tailor shop, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrɔsɪŋ ɑrmz ɪn ə ˈteɪlər ʃɑp, ʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 在裁縫店交叉雙手，好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does the back feel, tight or free?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz ðə bæk fil, taɪt ɔr fri?/
dialogue.zh: 背後感覺如何，緊還是鬆？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It pulls a bit when I reach high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pʊlz ə bɪt wɛn aɪ ritʃ haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 手舉高時會有一點拉力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I let out the back, one small move.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ lɛt aʊt ðə bæk, wʌn smɔl muv./
dialogue.zh: 那我把背後放一點，小動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small move, and I can reach my shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl muv, ænd aɪ kæn ritʃ maɪ ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 小放一點，我就夠得到架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you reach that high at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ritʃ ðæt haɪ æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 你在家常伸手拿那麼高的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My books live on the top row.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bʊks lɪv ɑn ðə tɑp roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的書都住在最上面一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that pull was older than your jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðæt pʊl wʌz ˈoʊldər ðæn jɔr ˈdʒækɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那拉扯比你的外套年紀還大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You read bodies like I read newspapers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rid ˈbɑdiz laɪk aɪ rid ˈnuzˌpeɪpərz./
dialogue.zh: 你看身體就像我看報紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn to the glass, look at yourself now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn tu ðə ɡlæs, lʊk æt jɔrˈsɛlf naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 轉向鏡子，看看現在的你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is me, but with a longer line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz mi, bʌt wɪð ə ˈlɔŋɡər laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那是我，但是線條變長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The eye likes a clean hem, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði aɪ laɪks ə klin hɛm, ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 眼睛喜歡乾淨的褲腳，永遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife will ask what happened to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf wɪl æsk wʌt ˈhæpənd tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 我太太會問我怎麼變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the tailor only fixed the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr ðə ˈteɪlər ˈoʊnli fɪkst ðə klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 就跟她說裁縫只修了布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the pins show through the front?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə pɪnz ʃoʊ θru ðə frʌnt?/
dialogue.zh: 針會透出前面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hide inside the fold, look here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ haɪd ɪnˈsaɪd ðə foʊld, lʊk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 它們藏在摺裡面，你看這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the collar gap, did you fix that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈkɑlər ɡæp, dɪd ju fɪks ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 那領子後面翹開的地方，你處理了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It closed when the shoulder sat right. See.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kloʊzd wɛn ðə ˈʃoʊldər sæt raɪt. si./
dialogue.zh: 肩縫對了就合了，你看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chalk line is on my shoe now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɔk laɪn ɪz ɑn maɪ ʃu naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 粉筆線現在畫到我的鞋上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brush it, white dust comes off fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /brʌʃ ɪt, waɪt dʌst kʌmz ɔf fæst./
dialogue.zh: 刷一下，白粉很快就掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we mark the right leg twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi mɑrk ðə raɪt lɛɡ twaɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們右邊的褲腿畫了兩次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left is lower, so it is shorter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft ɪz ˈloʊər, soʊ ɪt ɪz ˈʃɔrtər./
dialogue.zh: 左邊低一點，所以那一邊要短一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the pins out now, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə pɪnz aʊt naʊ, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 現在請把針都拔下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out, counted. Nine in, nine out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt, ˈkaʊntɪd. naɪn ɪn, naɪn aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 拔出來，數過了：進去九個，出來九個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You count pins like other people count money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kaʊnt pɪnz laɪk ˈʌðər ˈpipəl kaʊnt ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 你數針像別人數錢一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A lost pin in a coat bites someone later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔst pɪn ɪn ə koʊt baɪts ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 掉在外套裡的針之後會戳到人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a promise I like.
