dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈprɑmɪs aɪ laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這個承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now rest a minute, I write this all down.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ rɛst ə ˈmɪnɪt, aɪ raɪt ðɪs ɔl daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你先歇一下，我把這些都記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So when can I come for these?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn kæn aɪ kʌm fər ðiz?/
dialogue.zh: 那我什麼時候可以來取？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at my board first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk æt maɪ bɔrd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 讓我先看一下我的進度板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You keep the days on a board?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kip ðə deɪz ɑn ə bɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 你的排程都寫在一塊板上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three boards: waiting, sewing, ready to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri bɔrdz: ˈweɪtɪŋ, ˈsoʊɪŋ, ˈrɛdi tə ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 三塊：待改、車縫中、可取件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which board are my pants on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ bɔrd ɑr maɪ pænts ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 我的褲子在哪一塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now waiting, tonight they move to sewing.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ˈweɪtɪŋ, təˈnaɪt ðeɪ muv tə ˈsoʊɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 現在是待改，今晚進車縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many jobs are waiting tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni dʒɑbz ɑr ˈweɪtɪŋ təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚排隊的還有多少件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty two pieces, my machine and I.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu ˈpisɪz, maɪ məˈʃin ænd aɪ./
dialogue.zh: 二十二件，我和我機器兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty two! Does the machine rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu! dʌz ðə məˈʃin rɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 二十二！機器不用休息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rests when I drink my tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɛsts wɛn aɪ drɪŋk maɪ ti./
dialogue.zh: 我喝茶的時候它就休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then what day will mine be ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌt deɪ wɪl maɪn bi ˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 那我的是哪天會好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days: Thursday after four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz: ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ˈæftər fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 兩天：星期四四點以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday after four, write it for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ˈæftər fɔr, raɪt ɪt fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 週四四點後，請你寫給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, on the card, in big letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, ɑn ðə kɑrd, ɪn bɪɡ ˈlɛtərz./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，寫在單子上，字很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I come Friday instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kʌm ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɪnˈstɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以改成星期五來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is fine, but later in the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɪz faɪn, bʌt ˈleɪtər ɪn ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 星期五可以，但要下午晚一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My Fridays are full until five.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfraɪˌdeɪz ɑr fʊl ənˈtɪl faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我星期五都忙到五點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then five fifteen, I am still here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn faɪv fɪfˈtin, aɪ æm stɪl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那五點十五，我還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You stay until five fifteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju steɪ ənˈtɪl faɪv fɪfˈtin?/
dialogue.zh: 你會待到五點十五？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I stay until the last customer leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ steɪ ənˈtɪl ðə læst ˈkʌstəmər livz./
dialogue.zh: 我待到最後一位客人離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is kind, but also tiring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd, bʌt ˈɔlsoʊ ˈtaɪərɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 人很好，但也會累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closing time is my quiet sewing time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊzɪŋ taɪm ɪz maɪ ˈkwaɪət ˈsoʊɪŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 打烊後是安靜縫東西的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you open on Saturday morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈoʊpən ɑn ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 星期六上午開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten until one, then I close.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɛn ənˈtɪl wʌn, ðɛn aɪ kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 開，十點到一點，然後休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only three hours on Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli θri ˈaʊərz ɑn ˈsætərˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 星期六只有三小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My daughter visits on Saturdays.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɔtər ˈvɪzɪts ɑn ˈsætərˌdeɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我女兒星期六會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a better reason than work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈbɛtər ˈrizən ðæn wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 這個理由比工作好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She brings soup, we eat and I sew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi brɪŋz sup, wi it ænd aɪ soʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她帶湯來，我們吃，我縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my son's event is Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, maɪ sʌnz ɪˈvɛnt ɪz ˈsætərˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我兒子的活動在星期六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which Saturday is that, this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈsætərˌdeɪ ɪz ðæt, ðɪs wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 那是哪個週六，這週嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one in three weeks, for my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn ɪn θri wikz, fər maɪ sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 三週後那一天，為了我兒子的典禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Friday is plenty early for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɪz ˈplɛnti ˈɜrli fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 那星期五拿對你還早得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday late, that is my plan too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ leɪt, ðæt ɪz maɪ plæn tu./
dialogue.zh: 星期五傍晚，這也是我的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you free at five fifteen, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju fri æt faɪv fɪfˈtin, ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 五點十五你剛好有空嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can be there, five fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn bi ðɛr, faɪv fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 我可以到，五點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I press them and hang them for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ prɛs ðɛm ænd hæŋ ðɛm fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 那我就燙好、掛起來等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hung on a hanger, not folded?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌŋ ɑn ə ˈhæŋɡər, nɑt ˈfoʊldɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 用衣架掛著，不是折起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pants hang, shirts fold, that is my rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /pænts hæŋ, ʃɜrts foʊld, ðæt ɪz maɪ rul./
dialogue.zh: 褲子掛、襯衫折，這是我的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I cannot come Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ ˈkænɑt kʌm ˈfraɪˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我星期五來不了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep them two weeks, no extra charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ðɛm tu wikz, noʊ ˈɛkstrə tʃɑrdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 我幫你保存兩週，不加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks is a long time here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz ɪz ə lɔŋ taɪm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 兩週在這裡算很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My rack is full, but yours has a hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ræk ɪz fʊl, bʌt jʊrz hæz ə hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 我的衣架很滿，但你有一個鉤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And after two weeks?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈæftər tu wikz?/
dialogue.zh: 那兩週之後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I call, then I mail, then I keep waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kɔl, ðɛn aɪ meɪl, ðɛn aɪ kip ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我打電話，然後寄信，然後繼續等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You would mail me about my pants?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wʊd meɪl mi əˈbaʊt maɪ pænts?/
dialogue.zh: 你會為了我的褲子寄信給我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I mail everyone, it is my only hobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ meɪl ˈɛvriˌwʌn, ɪt ɪz maɪ ˈoʊnli ˈhɑbi./
dialogue.zh: 我每個人都寄，這是唯一的嗜好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A phone call is easier than mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə foʊn kɔl ɪz ˈizɪər ðæn meɪl./
dialogue.zh: 打電話比寄信容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me a number, then I text you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ə ˈnʌmbər, ðɛn aɪ tɛkst ju./
dialogue.zh: 留一個號碼給我，我就傳訊給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My number ends with three sevens.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈnʌmbər ɛndz wɪθ θri ˈsɛvənz./
dialogue.zh: 我的電話末碼是三個七。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three sevens, easy to remember, clever.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈsɛvənz, ˈizi tə rɪˈmɛmbər, ˈklɛvər./
dialogue.zh: 三個七，很好記，聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not choose it, my wife did.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt tʃuz ɪt, maɪ waɪf dɪd./
dialogue.zh: 這不是挑的，我太太挑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wives choose numbers, we choose thread colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪvz tʃuz ˈnʌmbərz, wi tʃuz θrɛd ˈkʌlərz./
dialogue.zh: 太太挑號碼，我們挑線的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you match the thread exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju mætʃ ðə θrɛd ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 線會完全對到色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hold six shades on the cloth first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊld sɪks ʃeɪdz ɑn ðə klɑθ fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我會先在布上試六種深淺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six shades for one gray pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ʃeɪdz fər wʌn ɡreɪ pɛr./
dialogue.zh: 一條灰褲子要用六種色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gray is hard, it hides pink and green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ ɪz hɑrd, ɪt haɪdz pɪŋk ænd ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 灰色難對，會藏粉紅和綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who taught you gray is hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu tɔt ju ɡreɪ ɪz hɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 是誰教你灰色很難對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The day I sewed blue on gray by mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə deɪ aɪ soʊd blu ɑn ɡreɪ baɪ mɪˈsteɪk./
dialogue.zh: 是我把藍線車到灰布的那天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pick it all out?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju pɪk ɪt ɔl aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 你把線全拆掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every stitch, with small tweezers, one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri stɪtʃ, wɪð smɔl twiˈzərz, wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 每一針都用小鑷子拆，花了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That hour made you better at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈaʊər meɪd ju ˈbɛtər æt ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那一小時讓你現在更厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It made me slow, and slow is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪd mi sloʊ, ænd sloʊ ɪz raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它讓我變慢，慢才是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to my plan: Friday, five fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə maɪ plæn: ˈfraɪˌdeɪ, faɪv fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 回到我的安排：星期五、五點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And bring the ticket, the little half card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd brɪŋ ðə ˈtɪkɪt, ðə ˈlɪtəl hæf kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 記得帶號碼單，那半張小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I put it in my wallet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt ɪt ɪn maɪ ˈwɑlət naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在把它放進錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not lose it, the number is my map.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt luz ɪt, ðə ˈnʌmbər ɪz maɪ mæp./
dialogue.zh: 別弄丟，號碼是我的地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your map to my gray pants.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr mæp tə maɪ ɡreɪ pænts./
dialogue.zh: 通往灰褲子的地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also to your blue shirt, same hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ tə jɔr blu ʃɜrt, seɪm hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 也到你的藍襯衫，挂在同一個鉤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If my friend comes, will you hand it over?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf maɪ frɛnd kʌmz, wɪl ju hænd ɪt ˈoʊvər?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我朋友來，你會給他嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with the card and your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɪð ðə kɑrd ænd jɔr neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 要帶著小卡，還要報出你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this card is like a house key.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs kɑrd ɪz laɪk ə haʊs ki./
dialogue.zh: 所以這張卡就像一串鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I also look at the face, do not laugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ lʊk æt ðə feɪs, du nɑt læf./
dialogue.zh: 我也會看臉，別笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is smart, cloth has no ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz smɑrt, klɑθ hæz noʊ aɪˈdi./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，布料沒有身分證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth lies often, faces rarely do.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɑθ laɪz ˈɔfən, ˈfeɪsəz ˈrɛrli du./
dialogue.zh: 布常常撒謊，臉比較不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if rain stops me Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf reɪn stɑps mi ˈfraɪˌdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 如果星期五下雨擋住我怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then come Saturday before one, I will wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌm ˈsætərˌdeɪ bɪˈfɔr wʌn, aɪ wɪl weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就星期六一點前來，我會等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will wait for one person?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl weɪt fər wʌn ˈpɜrsən?/
dialogue.zh: 你會為一個人等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My daughter brings extra soup, we can talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɔtər brɪŋz ˈɛkstrə sup, wi kæn tɔk./
dialogue.zh: 我女兒會多帶湯，我們可以聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you closed next week at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju kloʊzd nɛkst wik æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 下週你們會不會關店？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wednesday is closed, it is my market day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛnzˌdeɪ ɪz kloʊzd, ɪt ɪz maɪ ˈmɑrkɪt deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 星期三關閉，那是我的市集日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your market day, that sounds nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈmɑrkɪt deɪ, ðæt saʊndz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你的市集日，聽起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old buttons there, better than any shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈbʌtənz ðɛr, ˈbɛtər ðæn ˈɛni ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那裡有舊扣子，比店裡的好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the shop be busy when I come?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ʃɑp bi ˈbɪzi wɛn aɪ kʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 我去的時候店裡會很忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fridays fill up, some people wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪz fɪl ʌp, sʌm ˈpipəl weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 星期五會客滿，有人要排隊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not mind, I can bring a book.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt maɪnd, aɪ kæn brɪŋ ə bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 我不介意，我可以帶本書來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books are good, my chair faces the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks ɑr ɡʊd, maɪ tʃɛr ˈfeɪsəz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 看書最好，我的椅子正對窗戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call if I am running late?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ɪf aɪ æm ˈrʌnɪŋ leɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我遲到，要先打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text once, my Friday girl reads the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst wʌns, maɪ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɡɜrl ridz ðə foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 傳個訊就好，星期五那女孩會看手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I park for the pickup?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pɑrk fər ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我取件時車要停哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lot behind the bakery, five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɑt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈbeɪkəri, faɪv ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 麵包店後面的停車場，走五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last question about the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 最後一個關於當天的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask it, my kettle is still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪt, maɪ ˈkɛtl ɪz stɪl wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 你問，我的水壺還溫著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try them on at your counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ traɪ ðɛm ɑn æt jɔr ˈkaʊntər?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在你櫃台那裡試穿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the mirror stands there always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ðə ˈmɪrər stændz ðɛr ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 當然，鏡子一直在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will bring the boots with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ðə buts wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 我會把那雙靴子一起帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we will check the hem on both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, wi wɪl tʃɛk ðə hɛm ɑn boʊθ./
dialogue.zh: 好，兩種鞋我們都對一次褲腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if it is still not right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ɪt ɪz stɪl nɑt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果還是沒有正好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I unpick one seam, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ˌʌnˈpɪk wʌn sim, noʊ tʃɑrdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 那我就拆一條縫重車，不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No charge at all? You are serious?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ æt ɔl? ju ɑr ˈsɪriəs?/
dialogue.zh: 完全不收？你是認真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Serious, my name is on this shop door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪriəs, maɪ neɪm ɪz ɑn ðɪs ʃɑp dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 認真，我的名字就寫在門上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one more thing, in this second bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, wʌn mɔr θɪŋ, ɪn ðɪs ˈsɛkənd bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 等等，還有一件，在這個袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You came prepared, that is rare here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju keɪm priˈpɛrd, ðæt ɪz rɛr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你有備而來，這在店裡很少見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My winter coat, look at the zipper.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɪntər koʊt, lʊk æt ðə ˈzɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 我的冬外套，你看這個拉鍊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is open at the very top end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈoʊpən æt ðə ˈvɛri tɑp ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 最上面那邊開著一道口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It never closes fully now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈnɛvər ˈkloʊzɪz ˈfʊli naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它現在都合不緊到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the tab once, let me hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə tæb wʌns, lɛt mi hɪr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 拉一次拉頭，讓我聽聽聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hear that click? It does that always.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðæt klɪk? ɪt dʌz ðæt ˈɔlˌweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 聽到喀一聲了嗎？它每次都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The teeth are fine, the slider is tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði tiːθ ɑr faɪn, ðə ˈslaɪdər ɪz ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 齒是好的，是拉鍊頭磨損了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you change only that small part?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju tʃeɪndʒ ˈoʊnli ðæt smɔl pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 可以只換那個小零件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a new slider, and the zipper stays.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə nu ˈslaɪdər, ænd ðə ˈzɪpər steɪz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，換個新拉頭，拉鍊留下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does a slider cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ə ˈslaɪdər kɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 一個拉頭多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The part is two, the work is nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑrt ɪz tu, ðə wɜrk ɪz naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 零件兩塊，工錢九塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine for five minutes of work?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn fər faɪv ˈmɪnɪts əv wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘的活要九塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I open the lining, then I close it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə ˈlaɪnɪŋ, ðɛn aɪ kloʊz ɪt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我要先拆內裡，再縫回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lining, that is the soft inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlaɪnɪŋ, ðæt ɪz ðə sɔft ɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 內裡就是裡面那層滑滑的布？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it is sewn down the whole back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ɪt ɪz soʊn daʊn ðə hoʊl bæk./
dialogue.zh: 對，它沿整背都縫住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will cut those stitches?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl kʌt ðoʊz ˈstɪtʃɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 你要把那些線拆開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half, then I sew them back by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf, ðɛn aɪ soʊ ðɛm bæk baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 拆一半，再用手縫回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sewing by hand is slower than a machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊɪŋ baɪ hænd ɪz ˈsloʊər ðæn ə məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 手縫就是比機器慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, and the seam becomes invisible.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz, ænd ðə sim bɪˈkʌmz ɪnˈvɪzəbl./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，接縫就看不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do this on Friday too, with the pants.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðɪs ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪ tu, wɪð ðə pænts./
dialogue.zh: 這個也星期五處理吧，跟褲子一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I need the coat tonight, not Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ nid ðə koʊt təˈnaɪt, nɑt ˈsætərˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚就要外套，不是星期六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is in my hands right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪn maɪ hændz raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它現在就在我手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then let us look at the buttons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðɛn lɛt ʌs lʊk æt ðə ˈbʌtənz./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們來看鈕扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buttons? I did not mention buttons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtənz? aɪ dɪd nɑt ˈmɛnʃən ˈbʌtənz./
dialogue.zh: 鈕扣？我沒提過鈕扣啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two are missing on your left front side.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɑr ˈmɪsɪŋ ɑn jɔr lɛft frʌnt saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你左前面掉了兩顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You found that fast, I never look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju faʊnd ðæt fæst, aɪ ˈnɛvər lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 你找到好快，我從來不看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look inside this seam, a spare is tucked there.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs sim, ə spɛr ɪz tʌkt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 看這縫裡面，還藏著備用扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A spare button, in my own coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spɛr ˈbʌtən, ɪn maɪ oʊn koʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 備用扣，在我自己的外套裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most good coats hide one, makers plan ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ɡʊd koʊts haɪd wʌn, ˈmeɪkərz plæn əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 好外套都會藏一顆，廠商有計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sew those two back on for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðoʊz tu bæk ɑn fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 那就幫我把那兩顆縫回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, with thread matched to the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl, wɪð θrɛd mætʃt tə ðə klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 會，用對好色的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the same price as the slider?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə seɪm praɪs æz ðə ˈslaɪdər?/
dialogue.zh: 這個也跟拉頭一樣價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buttons are cheap, two dollars for the pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtənz ɑr tʃip, tu ˈdɑlərz fər ðə pɛr./
dialogue.zh: 扣子便宜，兩顆兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap is my favorite kind of news.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt kaɪnd əv nuz./
dialogue.zh: 便宜是我最喜歡的新聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not smile yet, the bag has more.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt smaɪl jɛt, ðə bæɡ hæz mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 先別笑，袋子裡還有東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife's skirt is in this bag too?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪfs skɜrt ɪz ɪn ðɪs bæɡ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我太太的裙子也在這個袋子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wrote her name on the inside tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi roʊt hɜr neɪm ɑn ði ɪnˈsaɪd tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 她在裡邊的標籤上寫了名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked me to bring only the coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt mi tə brɪŋ ˈoʊnli ðə koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 她只叫我帶外套來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she added this when you were not looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi ˈædɪd ðɪs wɛn ju wɜr nɑt ˈlʊkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那是你沒看到時她塞進來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is exactly her plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli hɜr plæn./
dialogue.zh: 這完全是她的安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is wrong with the waist of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz rɔŋ wɪð ðə weɪst əv ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 她的腰頭哪裡有問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The elastic has gone soft and wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɪˈlæstɪk hæz ɡɔn sɔft ænd waɪd./
dialogue.zh: 鬆緊帶變軟變鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New elastic solves that in one afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ɪˈlæstɪk sɑlvz ðæt ɪn wʌn ˌæftərˈnun./
dialogue.zh: 換新鬆緊帶，一下午就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it pinch her waist now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt pɪntʃ hɜr weɪst naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在會不會勒她的腰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ask her size first, or I call her.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æsk hɜr saɪz fɜrst, ɔr aɪ kɔl hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 我先問尺碼，不然打給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call her, she answers every call.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl hɜr, ʃi ˈænsərz ˈɛvri kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 打給她，她每次都接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I write the number on my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ raɪt ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn maɪ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 那我把電話寫在我的單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, she has two numbers now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ʃi hæz tu ˈnʌmbərz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 小心，她現在有兩組電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one is for cloth questions?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn ɪz fər klɑθ ˈkwɛstʃənz?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一號是用來問衣服的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old one, she keeps the new for friends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld wʌn, ʃi kips ðə nu fər frɛndz./
dialogue.zh: 舊的那號，新的留給朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call the old one, with the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ði oʊld wʌn, wɪð ðə klɑθ./
dialogue.zh: 那我就打舊的那號，說衣服的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My life becomes your phone list today.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ laɪf bɪˈkʌmz jɔr foʊn lɪst təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我今天的生活變成你的電話錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloth connects people, that is the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɑθ kəˈnɛkts ˈpipəl, ðæt ɪz ðə dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 布把人連起來，這就是工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coat pocket bag is torn inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ koʊt ˈpɑkɪt bæɡ ɪz tɔrn ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我外套的口袋內布破了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New bag cloth, that one is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu bæɡ klɑθ, ðæt wʌn ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 換一塊袋布，那個我不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you match the soft brown cloth?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju mætʃ ðə sɔft braʊn klɑθ?/
dialogue.zh: 你能找到一樣的軟棕色布嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep brown cloth for that, in three shades.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip braʊn klɑθ fər ðæt, ɪn θri ʃeɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 我留著棕色布，就有三種深淺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You keep spare cloth in brown shades?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kip spɛr klɑθ ɪn braʊn ʃeɪdz?/
dialogue.zh: 你會存著各種棕色餘布？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old coats give cloth, I cut and save it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld koʊts ɡɪv klɑθ, aɪ kʌt ænd seɪv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 舊外套會給布，我剪下來收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son's uniform has a broken zipper.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌnz ˈjʊnəˌfɔrm hæz ə ˈbroʊkən ˈzɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子制服的拉鍊壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Metal teeth? Those I can often save.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛtəl tiːθ? ðoʊz aɪ kæn ˈɔfən seɪv./
dialogue.zh: 金屬齒嗎？那種我常常救得回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, metal, it came off one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈmɛtəl, ɪt keɪm ɔf wʌn saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 是金屬的，一邊脫出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the uniform, a new stop will fix it.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ˈjunɪˌfɔrm, ə nu stɑp wɪl fɪks ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把制服帶來，換一個新的止扣就修好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And on my wife's skirt, new hooks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɑn maɪ waɪfs skɜrt, nu hʊks./
dialogue.zh: 還有我太太那條裙子，要換鉤扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hook and eye, or a soft elastic band?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʊk ænd aɪ, ɔr ə sɔft ɪˈlæstɪk bænd?/
dialogue.zh: 鉤跟扣眼，還是軟鬆緊帶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hooks, she says the band digs her waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʊks, ʃi sɛz ðə bænd dɪɡz hɜr weɪst./
dialogue.zh: 用鉤，她說那條帶子勒她的腰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hooks, then. Elastic alone never holds.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʊks, ðɛn. ɪˈlæstɪk əˈloʊn ˈnɛvər hoʊldz./
dialogue.zh: 那就用鉤，光靠鬆緊帶撐不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more small thing, my shirt cuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr smɔl θɪŋ, maɪ ʃɜrt kʌf./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件小事，我的袖口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little button there came loose already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈbʌtən ðɛr keɪm lus ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 那裡的小扣子已經鬆了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It hangs by one thread, I saw it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæŋz baɪ wʌn θrɛd, aɪ sɔ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它只用一條線掛著，我看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not pull it, the hole will grow.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt pʊl ɪt, ðə hoʊl wɪl ɡroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 別扯，洞口會越變越大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I bring the shirt to you tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ brɪŋ ðə ʃɜrt tə ju təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚把襯衫帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shirt is already on my hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɜrt ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn maɪ hʊk./
dialogue.zh: 襯衫已經掛在我的鉤上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, you have it, I forgot completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ju hæv ɪt, aɪ fərˈɡɑt kəmˈplitli./
dialogue.zh: 對，在你這裡，我全忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will sew that small button today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl soʊ ðæt smɔl ˈbʌtən təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天我就把那顆小扣縫好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what is my new total now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, wʌt ɪz maɪ nu ˈtoʊtəl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那我現在的總價是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty one, if we count the coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti wʌn, ɪf wi kaʊnt ðə koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 五十一，把外套也算進去的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my wife's skirt, that is extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ waɪfs skɜrt, ðæt ɪz ˈɛkstrə?/
dialogue.zh: 我太太的裙子是另外的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hooks are fourteen, she can pay them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði hʊks ɑr fɔrˈtin, ʃi kæn peɪ ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 鉤扣十四塊，讓她自己付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will pay, she always pays for skirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl peɪ, ʃi ˈɔlˌweɪz peɪz fər skɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 她會付，她買裙子都花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does she need the skirt by Friday also?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi nid ðə skɜrt baɪ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 她的裙子也要星期五拿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, she said no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ʃi sɛd noʊ rʌʃ æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 不，她說完全不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the skirt goes to the back table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə skɜrt ɡoʊz tə ðə bæk ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 那裙子就放到裡面的桌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back table, is that a slow place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ˈteɪbəl, ɪz ðæt ə sloʊ pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 裡面那張桌，是慢線的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the careful place, nothing is slow here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈkɛrfəl pleɪs, ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz sloʊ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那是細心的位置，沒有東西算慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything here has a system.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ hɪr hæz ə ˈsɪstəm./
dialogue.zh: 這裡每樣事都有一個系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tables, hooks, boards, pins, all with places.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪbəlz, hʊks, bɔrdz, pɪnz, ɔl wɪð ˈpleɪsəz./
dialogue.zh: 桌子、鉤子、板子、別針，都有位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does my coat sleep tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz maɪ koʊt slip təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的外套今晚睡在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the third hook, away from the steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə θɜrd hʊk, əˈweɪ frʌm ðə stim./
dialogue.zh: 第三個鉤上，離蒸氣遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Away from steam, why is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪ frʌm stiːm, waɪ ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 離蒸氣遠，為什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet marks on wool stay for weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt mɑrks ɑn wʊl steɪ fər wikz./
dialogue.zh: 羊毛上的水痕會留好幾週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You think about cloth all night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɪŋk əˈbaʊt klɑθ ɔl naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你整晚都在想布料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think in cloth, yes, my family knows.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪn klɑθ, jɛs, maɪ ˈfæməli noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我用布料思考，我的家人都知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they hang their coats on your hooks?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ hæŋ ðɛr koʊts ɑn jɔr hʊks?/
dialogue.zh: 他們也會把外套掛到你的鉤上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother brings one coat every March.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðər brɪŋz wʌn koʊt ˈɛvri mɑrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽每年三月都拿一件外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And you alter your own mother's coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju ˈɔltər jɔr oʊn ˈmʌðərz koʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 那你也改自己媽媽的外套？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do, and she pays me in plum cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du, ænd ʃi peɪz mi ɪn plʌm keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 會，她用李餅付我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plum cake, that is the best money.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌm keɪk, ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 李餅，那是最好的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, cake and pins, we eat while you try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪdeɪ, keɪk ænd pɪnz, wi it waɪl ju traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 星期五那天，蛋糕跟別針都有，我們邊吃邊看你試穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five fifteen exactly, I made it.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv fɪfˈtin ɪɡˈzæktli, aɪ meɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 五點十五整，我趕到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You came on time, my favorite thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju keɪm ɑn taɪm, maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你準時來，是我最喜歡的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rain let up two blocks ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə reɪn lɛt ʌp tu blɑks əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 雨在兩個街口前停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake your coat, I have a mat there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk jɔr koʊt, aɪ hæv ə mæt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 外套抖一抖，那裡有墊子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my pants ready, the gray pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr maɪ pænts ˈrɛdi, ðə ɡreɪ pɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的褲子好了嗎，那條灰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First hook, pressed and covered today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst hʊk, prɛst ænd ˈkʌvərd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 第一個鉤上，今天燙好也包好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Covered in paper, like a gift again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvərd ɪn ˈpeɪpər, laɪk ə ɡɪft əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 用紙包著，又像一份禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it out slowly, the edge is still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt aʊt ˈsloʊli, ði ɛdʒ ɪz stɪl wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢拿出來，褲邊還熱著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the crease is sharp as a knife.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðə kris ɪz ʃɑrp æz ə naɪf./
dialogue.zh: 喔，這道折線快得像刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pressed twice, once with a cloth on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛst twaɪs, wʌns wɪð ə klɑθ ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我燙了兩次，第二次墊了布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why twice? I only press once at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ twaɪs? aɪ ˈoʊnli prɛs wʌns æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要燙兩次？我在家都只燙一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once sets the shape, once kills the shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns sɛts ðə ʃeɪp, wʌns kɪlz ðə ʃaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 第一次定型，第二次去掉亮光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shiny wool looks cheap and old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃaɪni wʊl lʊks tʃip ænd oʊld./
dialogue.zh: 發亮的羊毛看起來又便宜又舊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that is why my iron waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ðæt ɪz waɪ maɪ ˈaɪərn weɪts./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，我的熨斗才會慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me look at the hem edge now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk æt ði hɛm ɛdʒ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 讓我現在看一下褲腳的邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it up, yes, there is my hidden work.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ʌp, jɛs, ðɛr ɪz maɪ ˈhɪdən wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 把褲腳翻上來，對，那是我暗縫的活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot see where the old edge was.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt si wɛr ði oʊld ɛdʒ wʌz./
dialogue.zh: 我完全看不出原本的褲邊在哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the point of twenty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt əv ˈtwɛnti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 這就是那二十塊的意義。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, here is a loose thread.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, hɪr ɪz ə lus θrɛd./
dialogue.zh: 等等，這裡有一條鬆掉的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? Ah, I will cut it, do not pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr? ɑ, aɪ wɪl kʌt ɪt, du nɑt pʊl./
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？啊，我來剪，你不要扯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always pull them, then knots appear.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz pʊl ðɛm, ðɛn nɑts əˈpɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我總愛去扯，然後就打結了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Threads must be cut, never dragged out.
dialogue.phonetic: /θrɛdz mʌst bi kʌt, ˈnɛvər dræɡd aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 線頭只能剪，不能硬拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your scissors came out of nowhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈsɪzərz keɪm aʊt əv noʊˈwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你的剪刀不知道從哪裡冒出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small snips live in my apron pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl snɪps lɪv ɪn maɪ əˈprɑn ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 小剪刀住在我的圍裙口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there more threads inside the leg?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr mɔr θrɛdz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə lɛɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 褲管裡面還有線頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us check, turn both legs inside out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tʃɛk, tɜrn boʊθ lɛɡz ɪnˈsaɪd aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我們檢查一下，兩條褲腿翻過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is embarrassing, pants on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˌɛmˈbærəsɪŋ, pænts ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 這有點難為情，褲子攤在櫃台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every good pair goes through this table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ɡʊd pɛr ɡoʊz θru ðɪs ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 每條好褲子都要經過這張桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two white threads here, and one black.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu waɪt θrɛdz hɪr, ænd wʌn blæk./
dialogue.zh: 這裡兩條白線，還有一條黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The black is mine, I sew dark seams today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blæk ɪz maɪn, aɪ soʊ dɑrk simz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 黑的是我的線，今天車深色縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is there white thread at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðɛr waɪt θrɛd æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼會有白線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stray from another pair, my fault, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə streɪ frʌm əˈnʌðər pɛr, maɪ fɔlt, ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 是別的褲子留下的，我的錯，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said sorry twice in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ˈsɑri twaɪs ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你一分鐘說了兩次抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut, cut, gone, now look again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt, kʌt, ɡɔn, naʊ lʊk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 剪、剪、掉了，現在再看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean, not one hair of thread left.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin, nɑt wʌn hɛr əv θrɛd lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 乾淨了，一根線毛都不剩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose hair shows every seam to the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus hɛr ʃoʊz ˈɛvri sim tə ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鬆線毛會在光下洩露每一道縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put these on now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ pʊt ðiz ɑn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在要在哪裡穿上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room is free, the glass is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum ɪz fri, ðə ɡlæs ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 試衣間空著，鏡子就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in the room, it feels strange to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn ðə rum, ɪt filz streɪndʒ tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 又回到這間，我覺得怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange the first time, normal the second.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪndʒ ðə fɜrst taɪm, ˈnɔrməl ðə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 第一次都怪，第二次就正常了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here I am, and it feels different.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr aɪ æm, ænd ɪt filz ˈdɪfərənt./
dialogue.zh: 我出來了，感覺完全不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look down, what do your eyes find?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk daʊn, wʌt du jɔr aɪz faɪnd?/
dialogue.zh: 低頭看看，你的眼睛發現了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One fold, just one, at the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn foʊld, dʒʌst wʌn, æt ðə frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 一道摺，就一道，在前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One soft fold, exactly what we planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɔft foʊld, ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt wi plænd./
dialogue.zh: 一道軟摺，正是我們當初計畫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You planned this one fold for today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju plænd ðɪs wʌn foʊld fər təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 連這一道摺都是你算好的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fold is a choice, never an accident.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə foʊld ɪz ə tʃɔɪs, ˈnɛvər æn ˈæksədənt./
dialogue.zh: 一道摺是選擇，從來不是意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back is flat, no wing at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ɪz flæt, noʊ wɪŋ æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 後面平平的，一點都不張開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn slow, I want to see the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn sloʊ, aɪ wɑnt tə si ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉，我想看臀部那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No lines across, the cloth just lies.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ laɪnz əˈkrɔs, ðə klɑθ dʒʌst laɪz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有橫紋，布就乖乖躺平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because we moved two darts, nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈkɔz wi muvd tu dɑrts, ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 因為我們只收了兩個省道，沒動別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting test now, chair or stool?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ tɛst naʊ, tʃɛr ɔr stuːl?/
dialogue.zh: 現在做坐測試，坐椅子還是凳子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stool, it is lower, like your office chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði stuːl, ɪt ɪz ˈloʊər, laɪk jɔr ˈɔfəs tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 凳子，比較矮，像你辦公室的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sit, I breathe, nothing cuts my waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɪt, aɪ briːð, ˈnʌθɪŋ kʌts maɪ weɪst./
dialogue.zh: 我坐著、呼吸，腰都沒有被勒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the darts are honest and correct.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə dɑrts ɑr ˈɑnɪst ænd kəˈrɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 那就代表省道車得老實又正確。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought the boots, here is the pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt ðə buts, hɪr ɪz ðə pɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我把靴子帶來了，就是這一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them on, then walk your normal loop.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm ɑn, ðɛn wɔk jʊr ˈnɔrməl lup./
dialogue.zh: 穿上它們，再照你平常的速度走一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hem swings, it does not drag now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɛm swɪŋz, ɪt dʌz nɑt dræɡ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 褲腳在擺，不再拖地了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boots or flats, the length stays the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /buts ɔr flæts, ðə lɛŋθ steɪz ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 穿靴子或平底鞋，長度都一樣剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the coat, let's test that zipper.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə koʊt, lɛts tɛst ðæt ˈzɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 現在來試外套的拉鍊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, pull it once from the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, pʊl ɪt wʌns frʌm ðə ˈbɑtəm./
dialogue.zh: 給，從最下面一次拉上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth! No click, nothing stuck inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /smuːð! noʊ klɪk, ˈnʌθɪŋ stʌk ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 好順！沒有喀聲，也不會卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new slider grips the teeth gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nu ˈslaɪdər ɡrɪps ðə tiːθ ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 新的拉頭輕輕咬住拉鍊齒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pull on these new buttons?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pʊl ɑn ðiz nu ˈbʌtənz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以扯一下這幾顆新扣子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cross stitch holds them, test it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, krɔs stɪtʃ hoʊldz ðɛm, tɛst ɪt wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 可以，它們是十字縫法，用力試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tug two, they do not move at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʌɡ tu, ðeɪ du nɑt muv æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我扯了兩顆，它們完全不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cross also lifts the button a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə krɔs ˈɔlsoʊ lɪfts ðə ˈbʌtən ə ˈlɪtl./
dialogue.zh: 十字縫也會把扣子墊高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taller? That is a button detail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɔlər? ðæt ɪz ə ˈbʌtən ˈditeɪl./
dialogue.zh: 站高？這也算扣子的細節？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tall button is easier to close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɔl ˈbʌtən ɪz ˈizɪər tə kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 扣子站高，比較好扣上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt, is the sleeve shorter now?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrt, ɪz ðə sliv ˈʃɔrtər naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的襯衫，袖子變短了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on, raise your arms, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn, reɪz jɔr ɑrmz, lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 穿上，抬手，你自己看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a centimeter, just like you said.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə ˈsɛntəˌmitər, dʒʌst laɪk ju sɛd./
dialogue.zh: 半公分，跟你說的完全一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the cuff button, is it firm?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə kʌf ˈbʌtən, ɪz ɪt fɜrm?/
dialogue.zh: 袖口那顆扣子，穩不穩？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Firm, I tug it, it does not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm, aɪ tʌɡ ɪt, ɪt dʌz nɑt muv./
dialogue.zh: 很穩，我扯它，它都不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any chalk left on the gray cloth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni tʃɔk lɛft ɑn ðə ɡreɪ klɑθ?/
dialogue.zh: 灰布上還有粉筆痕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None, but I look with my glasses on.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn, bʌt aɪ lʊk wɪð maɪ ˈɡlæsəz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，不過我是戴著眼鏡在看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the brush, here, one quick pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ðə brʌʃ, hɪr, wʌn kwɪk pæs./
dialogue.zh: 那就拿刷子快速刷一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brush my own new pants at your shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brʌʃ maɪ oʊn nu pænts æt jɔr ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我在你店裡刷自己的新褲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A checking customer is a good customer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtʃɛkɪŋ ˈkʌstəmər ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈkʌstəmər./
dialogue.zh: 會檢查的客人才是好客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is left for me to pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz lɛft fər mi tə peɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我還剩多少要付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second half, plus the coat work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈsɛkənd hæf, plʌs ðə koʊt wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 後一半，再加上外套的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nineteen was the half, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌnaɪnˈtin wʌz ðə hæf, ɪz ðæt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 一半是十九塊，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen, plus thirteen for the coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌnaɪnˈtin, plʌs θɜrˈtin fər ðə koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 十九，再加上外套的十三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty two, then. Here is forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti tu, ðɛn. hɪr ɪz ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 那就是三十二，這四十給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight back, my drawer stays honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt bæk, maɪ drɔr steɪz ˈɑnɪst./
dialogue.zh: 找你八塊，我的抽屜要誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then keep those eight for umbrellas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ðoʊz eɪt fər ʌmˈbrɛləz./
dialogue.zh: 那就把那八塊留著修傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I have an umbrella fund, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ hæv ən ʌmˈbrɛlə fʌnd, θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 我現在真的有一個修傘基金了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A receipt, or nothing at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪˈsit, ɔr ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 要收據嗎，還是什麼都不要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your stamp, keep it with the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz jɔr stæmp, kip ɪt wɪð ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 這是蓋了章的回條，跟小卡收在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I wash these at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ wɑʃ ðiz æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 回家我該怎麼洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry clean only, the tag still says it.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ klin ˈoʊnli, ðə tæɡ stɪl sɛz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 只能乾洗，標籤上還寫著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shirt: cold water, no hot spin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɜrt: koʊld ˈwɔtər, noʊ hɑt spɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 襯衫用冷水，不要熱水脫水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold wash, hang it, the crease will drop out.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld wɑʃ, hæŋ ɪt, ðə kris wɪl drɑp aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 冷水洗、掛著晾，皺痕會自己垂平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the coat, can it live in a bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə koʊt, kæn ɪt lɪv ɪn ə bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 外套可以長期裝在袋子裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it breathe, a closed bag creases wool.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt briːð, ə kloʊzd bæɡ ˈkrisɪz wʊl./
dialogue.zh: 讓它透氣，悶在袋裡會壓皺羊毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have taught me a whole winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv tɔt mi ə hoʊl ˈwɪntər./
dialogue.zh: 你等於教了我一個冬天的知識。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next March bring the coat, I check the slider.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mɑrtʃ brɪŋ ðə koʊt, aɪ tʃɛk ðə ˈslaɪdər./
dialogue.zh: 明年三月把外套帶來，我再檢查拉頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my wife's skirt, when is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd maɪ waɪfs skɜrt, wɛn ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 我太太那條裙子什麼時候好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday at noon, she may come herself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ æt nun, ʃi meɪ kʌm hɜrˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 星期六中午前，她可以自己來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good evening, and thank you truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈivənɪŋ, ænd θæŋk ju ˈtruli./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，真心謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the umbrella, then sleep well tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ði ʌmˈbrɛlə, ðɛn slip wɛl təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 記得帶那把傘，然後今晚好好睡。
